* Our Company values, **Best Together, Impact Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always, and Accountability with an "I"**, genuinely resonate with how you work and lead.
* You demonstrate the **Real Chemistry Can** mindset by approaching challenges with optimism, accountability, creativity, and a solutions-oriented attitude, always looking for ways to make a meaningful impact for our clients, colleagues, and communities.
* You are adaptable, resilient, and comfortable adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. As our business grows and changes, so do we.
* You are proactive, driven, and resourceful, with strong prioritization skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to leverage data to inform decisions and drive outcomes.
* You are energized by innovation and the transformative potential of AI, actively exploring new technologies, identifying opportunities to work smarter, and championing practical, responsible AI adoption that drives meaningful business impact.

* 10+ years healthcare/pharmaceutical Copywriting
* Experience in the healthcare/pharmaceutical industry in an agency setting required
* Portfolio or PDF of relevant work samples required

title: Art Director — Editorial Photography & Motion
description:

Sportiefs Matcha is a premium matcha collection under Maison Sportiefs, a lifestyle and wellness brand bringing together sport, culture, and everyday rituals.

We believe in creating experiences that extend beyond the product itself. Our creative approach emphasizes thoughtful design, refined aesthetics, and compelling visual storytelling.

As we continue developing our visual identity, we’re looking for an Art Director who can bring original concepts to life through photography, motion, and experimental visual production.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly creative, detail-oriented Art Director with expertise in editorial product photography, stop-motion animation, and mixed-media content production.

This is a hands-on creative position for someone who can take an idea from initial concept through production and final delivery.

The ideal candidate combines a strong artistic perspective with technical production skills and an understanding of premium consumer brands.

You’ll help shape the visual direction of Sportiefs Matcha across digital campaigns, product launches, e-commerce, and social media.

We are particularly interested in creatives who enjoy experimenting with composition, lighting, movement, textures, and unconventional storytelling techniques.

Creative Direction & Concept Development

* Translate brand references, mood boards, and creative briefs into distinctive visual concepts.

Editorial Photography & Studio Production

Post-Production & Creative Execution

* Oversee photo retouching, color correction, video editing, and animation.
* Maintain consistency in visual quality across all deliverables.
* Prepare final assets in appropriate formats for websites, digital advertising, and social media.
* Manage production timelines, creative assets, and project deliverables.

Qualifications & Experience

* A strong portfolio demonstrating editorial product photography, art direction, and visual storytelling.
* Experience producing stop-motion, mixed-media animation, or experimental motion content.
* Strong understanding of studio lighting, composition, color, texture, and product styling.
* Proficiency with professional photography and video equipment.

* E-commerce product imagery
* Product launch campaigns
* Short-form motion content

title: CREATIVE DIRECTOR
description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

This role leads the Jack Design Studio, overseeing internal creative talent and external partners to deliver distinctive, high-quality brand experiences across every customer touchpoint. As the steward of Jack in the Boxs visual identity and creative standards, this leader shapes and evolves the brands design language while translating creative vision into compelling, culturally relevant work across campaigns, digital channels, packaging, merchandising, and restaurant environments.

**KEY DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Creative Leadership & Brand Identity**

Owns and stewards the visual identity of Jack in the Box across all consumer-facing touchpoints, ensuring the brand is distinctive, recognizable and consistently executed which includes typography, color, graphic language, photography, illustration, iconography, motion and other core design elements.

Establishes the creative vision and design principles for the Jack Design Studio and sets a high bar for creative excellence, craft and originality.

Develops and maintains brand identity guidelines, creative toolkits, templates and design systems that enable consistent execution across internal teams, agencies, franchisees and external partners.

Protects brand consistency without allowing the brand to become formulaic, ensuring creative continues to feel fresh, culturally current and surprising.

**Jack Design Studio Leadership**

Creates a highly collaborative internal creative culture built around strong ideas, exceptional craft, speed and constructive creative feedback.

Establishes effective creative workflows, intake processes, prioritization and review standards in partnership with Marketing Operations.

Balances high-volume production needs with higher-order brand and creative development, ensuring the Studio operates as a creative engine rather than simply a production service.

**Restaurant Merchandising, Menu Boards & Point of Purchase**

Leads creative development and production of restaurant merchandising and point-of-purchase materials, ensuring every in-restaurant execution delivers against the brand identity and commercial objectives.

Oversees design and production of menu boards, promotional menu panels, window clings, counter materials, signage and other restaurant merchandising.

Partners with Menu & Product Marketing, Operations and Marketing Operations to translate marketing programs, menu innovation and value initiatives into compelling restaurant communication.

Develops scalable creative systems capable of supporting national programs, market-level differences, tests and rapid promotional changes.

**Digital & Customer Experience Design**

Oversees brand design across digital touchpoints, including web, app, CRM, paid digital media, social content and other digital customer experiences.

Partners with Digital & Growth Marketing to ensure the brand identity translates effectively into performance-oriented and transactional environments.

Establishes flexible digital design systems that enable high-volume content creation, versioning, localization and rapid optimization.

Ensures performance creative remains unmistakably Jack while meeting the functional requirements of digital channels.

**Integrated Campaign Creative & Agency Production**

Partners closely with Brand Marketing and external creative agencies in the development and production of integrated campaigns.

Represents the internal creative point of view throughout campaign concepting, design, production and adaptation.

Collaborates with agency partners on photography, content production, video, digital, social, experiential and other campaign assets.

Helps determine which creative work should be developed internally versus externally based on capabilities, complexity, speed and business need.

Ensures agency-developed campaigns translate seamlessly into the broader Jack visual ecosystem across restaurant, digital, CRM, merchandising and owned channels.

**Copy, Voice & Brand Expression**

Oversees internal copywriting resources and partners with Brand Marketing and external agencies to ensure copy reflects Jacks distinctive brand personality.

Helps translate brand positioning and creative strategy into recognizable verbal and visual expression.

Ensures headlines, merchandising copy, menu communication and tactical messaging are clear, compelling and consistent with the brand.

Partners with Public Relations, Social and Brand Marketing to maintain cohesion across visual and verbal brand expression.

**Marketing Calendar & Speed-to-Market**

Partners with Brand Marketing and Marketing Operations to anticipate creative requirements across the annual marketing calendar.

Develops modular creative assets and toolkits that enable faster local and franchisee execution while protecting brand consistency.

Identifies process improvements that reduce unnecessary rounds, handoffs and production complexity.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

Partners closely with Brand Marketing, Product Marketing, Digital & Growth, Public Relations, Social, Culinary/Product Development, Consumer Insights, Operations and Marketing Operations.

Serves as the organizations internal authority on visual brand expression and design quality.

Translates strategic and commercial objectives into compelling creative solutions rather than treating creative execution as an isolated downstream activity.

Partners with Marketing leadership and Marketing Operations to manage Studio resources and external production investments effectively.

Oversees vendor selection and management for printing, photography, design, production and specialized creative capabilities.

Maintains appropriate quality-control standards across high-volume print and digital production.

Performs other related duties, tasks and responsibilities as required, assigned and directed.

**Education** - Bachelors degree in Graphic Design, Advertising, Communications, Marketing, Fine Arts or a related field preferred.

**Experience** - Significant creative leadership experience within a consumer brand, restaurant, retail, entertainment, agency or similarly fast-paced marketing environment. Experience developing or evolving visual identity systems for a recognizable consumer brand. Restaurant, retail or other multi-location consumer experience required, particularly experience with menu boards, merchandising, signage and point-of-purchase communication.

Fosters a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and learning.

Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity and drive organizational alignment.

Champions cross-functional collaboration and teamwork.

Exceptional creative judgment and a highly developed eye for design, typography, photography, visual storytelling and craft.

title: Creative Director
description:
The Creative Director is the face of creative on their accounts. They lead concept development and the campaigns that grow out of it. On some of that work, they execute hands-on at a senior level. For the rest, they manage and develop the creative team producing it. They immerse themselves in their clients' businesses, technologies, and markets deeply enough to own the work and the relationship, and they hold the line on quality whether the work is theirs or the team's.

**Who You Are:**
================

* A creative leader who owns the work on your accounts, directing the team's output and holding the standard on everything that reaches a client.
* Still hands-on in the craft, executing at a senior level on the work that calls for it, and setting the bar by what you make as much as what you direct.
* Able to take a complex B2B business and find the idea that makes it land with real people, then sell it in the room.
* A developer of people, giving direct feedback, creating real opportunities, and taking your team's growth personally.
* Commercially sharp, running creative on your accounts profitably and building client relationships that grow.
* Ahead of the problem, whether that's work drifting off strategy, a team stretched too thin, or a client losing confidence.

**Key Responsibilities:**
=========================

Creative Direction & Craft

* Execute at a senior level on a subset of client work, from concept through production-ready files, taking on the projects that most need your hands.
* Lead the development and presentation of campaign concepts and key creative executions on your accounts.
* Deliver creative that meets clients' marketing and communications objectives, not just their aesthetic preferences.
* Write and present persuasive rationales for campaign approaches and defend the work in the room.
* Own brand consistency and unification across everything your accounts produce.
* Set the visual direction on your accounts, making the calls on typography, color, imagery, and how a piece moves the eye, and giving designers and art directors what they need to execute it.
* Make sure art and copy work together from concept through execution.

Team Leadership

* Manage and develop art directors, designers, and writers on your accounts, owning the quality of their work.
* Direct and review creative before it reaches clients, giving the feedback that makes the work and the person better.
* Own your direct reports' development through regular one-on-ones, growth plans, and stretch assignments.
* Lead critiques, ideation sessions, and creative reviews that raise what the team believes is possible.
* Balance assignments and capacity across your accounts and get ahead of workload risk before it reaches clients.
* Run creative on your accounts efficiently and profitably, working with project management on scope, resourcing, and timelines.

Account & Agency Partnership

* Serve as a core team member on your accounts alongside account, strategy, and channel leads.
* Immerse yourself in your clients' business, technology, products, and markets, and keep that knowledge current.
* Partner with strategy so creative is built on insight rather than assumption.
* Bring creative thinking to growth conversations and contribute to new business where your accounts or expertise fit.
* Keep the VP of Creative and account leadership informed on creative health, client relationships, and anything that could turn.

AI Leadership

* Identify workflows and task types across your team that could benefit from new AI tools or approaches.
* Test and pilot new tools, evaluating quality before recommending broader use.
* Support your team in applying approved tools appropriately, including where a tool should and shouldn't be used, and make sure they have the training and guidance.
* Reinforce Godfrey's AI usage policies and guidelines, and the expectation that AI output gets reviewed for quality, accuracy, and originality before it's relied on or shared.
* Surface promising tools, risks, and adoption concerns to the VP of Creative.

**Qualifications:**
===================

* Extensive agency creative experience, including leading campaign concepting and execution across print, digital, and web. B2B experience preferred.
* Experience managing and developing creative talent, including art directors, designers, and writers.
* Proven ability to judge concepts, art, and copy, give direction that makes the work better, and execute at a senior level yourself.
* Strong command of marketing principles and how creative connects to client business objectives.
* Experience presenting and selling creative work to client leadership.
* Digital and content fluency, including how creative performs across channels.
* Experience running creative profitably, including scope, resourcing, and timelines.
* Experience evaluating or rolling out tools and workflows across a team, including AI.
* Portfolio showing range, craft, and ideas that moved client businesses.

At Godfrey, we are guided by 5 core values that all team members are expected to embrace: Fascination, Drive, Partnership, Transparency and Community. By following these principles, we have become the driving force behind many B2B brands’ success stories.

CodeAI is an education innovation nonprofit dedicated to the vision that every student in every school has the opportunity to learn about artificial intelligence (AI) and computer science (CS) as part of their core K-12 education. We increase participation in AI+CS education by reaching students of all backgrounds where they are — at their skill level, in their schools, and in ways that inspire them to keep learning, with a focus on increasing participation by young women and students from other underrepresented groups. **A unifying approach in a divided world**

CodeAI's global role in the K-12 computer science movement is only possible because we use a unifying approach across diverse and often divided stakeholders. At a time of increasing polarization, the idea of increasing opportunity for students unites people from across the political spectrum. CodeAI's team members, students, teachers, and supporters have diverse and diverging view points, and they are all welcome in our mission. **Read more**.

**JOB SUMMARY**
---------------

As our Sr. Designer & Art Director, you'll bring the CodeAI brand to life through design, visual direction, and creative ideas across every channel we use. Reporting to the Executive Producer of Creative and Delivery, you'll lead the visual side of how our brand shows up everywhere and partner with our copywriter on integrated campaigns of every size.

This role leans toward design. You'll concept alongside your copywriter, direct the look of the work, and design much of it yourself, from video and social to out of home, experiential, and everyday channel assets. We have an established brand and campaigns already in market, and finding fresh ways to express them is at the heart of this job.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-------------------------------

In this role, you will own the visual direction of the CodeAI brand and design much of the work that carries it.

**Visual Direction & Design**

* Set the visual direction for campaigns and channel work, and design key pieces yourself, from key visuals to social, email, web, and paid assets.
* Bring strong typography, layout, composition, and color to every deliverable, and carry the work through to final, production-ready files.
* Design for motion and platform-native formats, including vertical video and social-first content.
* Build accessible work that meets WCAG standards across digital channels.
* Use AI tools in your design workflow and help the team keep pushing how we use them.

**Concepting & Art Direction**

* Concept integrated campaigns with your copywriter partner from first brief to final delivery, and translate each idea into a visual system that works across channels.
* Bring forward new ideas that engage our audiences and solve brand challenges, often before a brief asks for them.
* Art direct photo and video shoots from shot list through post, while production partners handle logistics and vendors.
* Direct contract designers and creatives when they're brought on, with clear feedback that raises the quality of the work.

**Brand Stewardship**

description:
**Say hello to Hagerty**  
Hagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers. We put our members at the center of everything we do, and are dedicated to making it easier and more enjoyable for enthusiasts to drive and celebrate the machines they love. We’re proud to be the world’s largest insurer of collectible and enthusiast vehicles and are home to the Hagerty Drivers Club, the world’s largest car club. As an **Art Director,** you’ll contribute to Hagerty’s creative output by developing design and concepts that bring the Hagerty brand to life across digital, print, video and event marketing. You’ll collaborate closely with Creative Directors, writers, strategists, and other team members to develop integrated campaigns and presentation decks for business and marketing need. Working as part of a cross-functional creative team, you’ll produce work that is compositionally strong, conceptually driven, and true to our brand’s distinct voice and visual identity. **What you’ll do**  
***Creative Concept Development***

* Work with Creative Directors and cross-functional teams to build presentation decks for business and marketing needs.

* You have experience in an advertising agency or strong in-house creative department, concepting, writing, and producing integrated brand and retail campaigns.

* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Figma.
* Understanding of brand visual identity guidelines and brand voice.
* Ability to follow creative direction and incorporate feedback effectively.

* Collaborative team player who communicates well with cross-functional teams.
* You’re curious about culture, advertising trends, emerging technologies, and new ways to tell stories.

**Requirements**

* A portfolio demonstrating conceptual thinking, art direction, and integrated advertising campaigns.
* Bachelor’s degree in Communication Design, Graphic Design, or a related field, or 3+ years of relevant professional experience.

**Job Summary**

The Social & Digital Art Director will concept, design, and direct visual content for pharmaceutical brands across social and digital channels. You will partner closely with copywriters, strategists, account teams, and production specialists to create visually compelling, strategically grounded, and medically compliant work from initial concept through final delivery.

You should be comfortable developing both individual social assets and scalable content systems that can support multiple platforms, placements, audience needs, and campaign phases. This role requires strong design craft, a current understanding of social behavior and digital formats, and the ability to translate complex brand and clinical information into clear, engaging visual storytelling.

**Job Responsibilities and Skills**

* Concept and design social-first and digital-first creative for pharmaceutical brands.

* Develop visual systems and polished assets for organic social, paid social, carousels, stories, reels, short-form video, motion content, display, web, and other digital formats.

* Partner with copywriters to develop integrated ideas in which visual storytelling and messaging work together across platforms.

* Translate brand strategy, campaign objectives, and complex clinical information into clear, engaging, consumer-appropriate visual communications.

* Create visual territories, mood boards, storyboards, social-content frameworks, design explorations, and presentation materials.

* Adapt creative work across platform specifications, placements, audience segments, and campaign phases while maintaining creative quality and brand consistency.

* Design with pharmaceutical promotional requirements in mind, including fair balance, required safety information, claims support, reference considerations, and annotation needs.

* Collaborate with motion designers, editors, illustrators, photographers, retouchers, and other production partners to ensure quality from concept through final delivery.

* Maintain a high standard of typography, layout, composition, color, imagery, accessibility, and brand consistency.

* Participate in creative reviews and present work clearly and persuasively to internal teams and clients.

* Stay current on social and digital design behaviors, emerging content formats, platform conventions, and visual trends.

* Manage multiple projects, revisions, and deadlines in a fast-paced agency environment.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, visual communications, fine arts, or a related discipline—or equivalent professional experience.

* 5+ years of art direction and design experience, including experience at a pharmaceutical promotional or healthcare advertising agency.

* Pharmaceutical promotional agency experience is required.

* Demonstrated experience designing social content and digital creative for pharmaceutical brands is required.

* A portfolio featuring strong examples of social-first and digital-first work, including paid social, organic social, short-form video or motion, responsive design systems, and platform-specific creative executions.

* Strong conceptual thinking combined with excellent hands-on design and execution skills.

* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign; Figma proficiency is strongly preferred.

* Experience collaborating with or directing motion designers, editors, illustrators, photographers, retouchers, and other production partners.

* Experience working within pharmaceutical medical, legal, and regulatory review processes; annotation and Veeva-submission experience is a plus.

* Strong communication, collaboration, presentation, organization, and time-management skills.

* Ability to work independently, respond constructively to feedback, and balance creative ambition with accuracy, compliance, and production realities.

**Portfolio requirement:** Applicants must submit a portfolio with clear examples of pharmaceutical social and digital design. Traditional print, detail aid, or general brand work alone is not sufficient.

description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Hook is a Creative Production Agency. With a collaborative, maker-centric team, and an emphasis on production-led design, we develop creative campaigns, short-form content, and websites for well-known brands.

Our mission is to integrate creative and production to help grow brands faster. But we believe what’s most important are the people who work with us and the experience they have along the way. We want clients to think of us as the best agency they’ve ever worked with, and we want everyone at Hook to feel like this is the best job they’ve had yet.

  

**WHAT’S AN ASSOCIATE DESIGN DIRECTOR AT HOOK?**

Hook is seeking a hands-on Associate Design Director to join one of our teams.

Associate Design Directors are experienced leaders who use design to exceed client goals, while working within the guard rails of existing brand marketing strategies. They operate alongside creative and motion teams, serving as a client-facing bridge between high-level brand strategy and systematic visual execution. They create robust visual languages and scalable design frameworks that power industry-leading content across static and animated mediums.

They are driven experts with a passion for making premium, ground-breaking work and a commitment to fostering the talents of the employees they collaborate with. They are fearless executors who elevate the work into new creative territories. They’re fundamentalists when it comes to digital design, but approach projects with rational and innovative mindsets, always mindful of how it looks and how it works.

Associate Design Directors are ready for hands-on projects at every stage of the life cycle, from brainstorming creative concepts with the project team and developing original campaigns, to participating in client presentations and ensuring deadlines are met, to building dynamic design systems and overseeing high-volume production rollouts that scale seamlessly across digital, video, print, and emerging platforms.

They have a well-established process for concept development, using visual presentations, storyboards, and mocks to communicate solutions to peers, leadership, and clients. They also excel at translating bold concepts into modular, extensible design systems. With expertise in design tokenization, asset automation, and end-to-end production pipelines, they ensure pixel-perfect, efficient client delivery at scale, always on time and on spec.

While this role would oversee tactical production workstreams, their responsibilities will also focus on strategic and conceptual visual design challenges for national and global brands/campaigns. With an existing design team in place, and opportunities to recruit additional talent, previous experience with team and project leadership within a rapid production environment will be a critical skill. Given the close proximity to marketing clients, being an excellent communicator and an overall joy-to-work-with will also go a long way toward success.

While this role can work from any approved location, this person must have the flexibility to work around PST hours as the team’s clients are based on the West Coast.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Demonstrate a mastery of visual design across design disciplines
* Execute, manage, and govern original, conceptual, and system-driven visual design work in line with agency standards and complex brand design systems
* Build and maintain comprehensive visual design systems, component libraries, and modular toolkits that empower teams to produce high-volume assets efficiently without losing creative fidelity
* Apply design rigor to provide mentorship to cross-functional teams with the goal of accelerating skill progression
* Inspire, oversee, and provide mentorship to design staff with the goal of accelerating skill progression through a culture of collaboration, experimentation, and knowledge sharing
* Fluently speak the language of design with both clients and creatives enabling effective feedback and direction
* Demonstrate emotional intelligence in all meetings and communications
* Work closely with creative staff to ensure design work goes above and beyond the expected
* Maintain and promote internal best practices around modern production design, tool integrations, automated workflows, and standardized asset handoffs

title: Senior Content Director
description:
**About Onnit:**

Onnit is an Austin, Texas based health and wellness company that sells dietary supplements direct to consumers and through retail distribution. As a trusted and serious supplement brand, we provide high-quality products with clinically studied ingredients designed to unlock a deeper mind-body connection and enhance both mental and physical performance. Unlike other supplement brands, Onnit enables strength from within, empowering individuals to operate at their peak every day. Backed by medical professionals, industry experts, and a loyal community, we are staying true to our mission of total human optimization.

We are part of the Wellbeing Collective, an exciting Global Business Unit within Unilever built with a start-up mindset. Our mission, with our science-backed and disruptive portfolio, is to improve the health and well-being of millions of consumers and continue leading in the Health and Wellness space.

If you are interested in joining a culture that strives for Curiosity, Discipline, Approachability, Commitment, and Ownership Mindset then we invite you to join our mission to optimize human potential!

**Why this role, why now**

Onnit is reinvigorating our content strategy and how people will see it. We're looking for a Senior Content Director to make Onnit the most watched, most shared, most recognizable brand in performance and wellness, without a Hollywood budget.

Onnit was built on a simple idea: train the total human, body and mind. That idea earned us a loyal community of athletes, fighters, lifters and everyday high performers, and a product line people swear by, from Alpha BRAIN to our kettlebells and steel maces.

As part of Unilever's Wellbeing Collective, we have the backing to go big. We're choosing to move like a startup.

We're writing Onnit's next chapter, and we want a content leader who sees that as the opportunity of a career. You'll define how Onnit looks, sounds and shows up everywhere: on a TikTok, a product page, a YouTube series, the side of a tub.

**The role**

The Senior Content Director owns Onnit's content strategy and output across every channel, and builds the in-house engine that produces it. This is a leadership role reporting to the CMO.

You'll set the creative direction, build a lean, high-velocity content operation, and turn our athletes, partners and customers into the stories that drive the brand.

You're equal parts strategist, storyteller and operator: someone who can write the brief in the morning, shoot it on a phone at lunch, and read the retention curve by dinner.

* Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer

* Scope: Social, YouTube, Onnit.com, email/CRM creative, Amazon and retail content, packaging, and new formats (podcast, series)

* Team: A small, scrappy in-house team plus a bench of freelancers, creators and partners you'll shape and grow

* Location: Remote, with a preference for Los Angeles, New York or Austin

**What You'll Own**

**1. Content strategy across every channel**

* Build and run one content strategy that spans social (TikTok, Instagram, X, Facebook), YouTube, Onnit.com, email/SMS, Amazon, retail and packaging.

* Decide what each channel is for, what we post, how often, and how pieces flow from one platform to the next.

* Turn brand and business priorities (launches, seasonal moments, retail resets, promotions) into a content calendar that ships on time.

* Own the content metrics: reach, engagement, watch time, follower growth, and the content's contribution to traffic and conversion.

**2. An ownable Onnit look and feel**

* Define the visual and verbal identity of Onnit content so a post is recognizably ours within the first second, with or without a logo.

* Create the playbook: tone of voice, formats, editing style, typography, color, sound, and the do's and don'ts that keep everyone on-brand.

* Make sure the same brand shows up on a 7-second Reel, a YouTube episode, a PDP and a package on shelf.

**3. A lean, in-house content engine**

* Build a content operation that produces a high volume of quality work without a big team, a studio or expensive equipment.

* Favor speed and iteration over polish: phone-first shoots, rapid edits, reusable templates, and one idea cut into many pieces.

* Set up the workflows, tools (including AI-assisted editing and production) and freelancer bench that let a small team punch far above its weight.

* Ship in days, not months. No months of storyboarding, no five-figure photo shoots for a single post.

**4. Algorithm-obsessed distribution**

* Know how each platform's algorithm rewards content right now, and adjust as it changes.

* Engineer for performance: hooks, retention, pacing, captions, thumbnails, posting cadence, trends and sounds.

* Own a real-time feedback loop: daily performance reads, a weekly content review, and a living scorecard by platform, format and talent. Double down on winners within days, kill what doesn't work, and feed every lesson straight back into the strategy.

* Use social listening and comment sections as a source of ideas, not just a metric.

**5. Athletes,** **talent** **and creators**

* Partner with Onnit athletes, ambassadors and personalities (from elite athletes and fighters to coaches, creators and everyday customers) to tell their stories in a way that feels real, not scripted.

* Help shape who we partner with, and get the most content value out of every relationship.

* Write clear, smart briefs for creators and influencers that protect the brand and leave room for the creator's voice.

* Work with the social and influencer lead to turn creator content into paid, organic and on-site assets.

**6. Community and fandom**

* Use content to turn customers into a community and a community into fans.

* Build recurring formats our audience shows up for: training series, challenges, education, behind-the-scenes, member and customer stories.

* Work with the community and events team so live moments become content, and content drives people to live moments.

**7. New formats: podcast, series and beyond**

* Develop and launch Onnit's own shows: a podcast, YouTube series, and other longform or episodic formats.

* Orchestrate the whole thing: concept, talent, production model, distribution and clipping strategy.

* Treat long-form as the engine that feeds short-form, and short-form as the funnel back to long-form.

**Who You'll Work With**

**Social & influencer lead:** Co-own the creator program, briefs, and the flow of creator content into owned and paid channels

**Community & events:** Turn events, challenges and member moments into content, and content into turnout

**Growth / performance marketing:** Supply and iterate creative for paid social and search; learn from what converts

**DTC (Onnit.com):** Bring the brand to life on the site: PDPs, landing pages, email and SMS creative

**Amazon:** Elevate listings, A+ content, brand store and video to lift conversion

**Retail:** Shelf-ready assets, packaging content and retailer marketing

**Product & innovation:** Tell the story behind new products from concept to launch

**CMO and leadership team:** Set direction, report on impact, and be a voice for the brand

**Qualifications**

Must-haves

* 12–15+ years in content, creative or brand storytelling, with at least 5 years leading content strategy and people for a consumer brand, media company or creator-led business.

* A portfolio that proves you can build an audience: channels you grew, formats you invented, content that moved real numbers.

* Deep, current fluency in platform algorithms across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube, and the instinct to change course when they shift.

* A builder's track record: you've stood up a lean, in-house content function and made it produce at volume.

* Hands-on craft. You can write, direct, and give sharp edit notes, and you're not above picking up the phone and shooting it yourself.

* Experience working with athletes, talent or creators, including writing briefs and managing those relationships.

* Modern storytelling instincts: you know a great story has to earn attention in the first two seconds and still mean something at the end.

* A relentless analytical mindset. You live in the numbers daily, not monthly: you always know what's working, what isn't and why. You turn those reads into changes in real time, shifting formats, hooks, talent, cadence and spend within days, not quarters. To you, the content strategy is a living system that gets smarter every week.

* Strong cross-functional leadership and the ability to rally many teams around one brand.

Big pluses

* Sports, fitness or an adjacent category (outdoor, combat sports, endurance, athleisure, gaming, wellness media).

* Supplements, beauty or wellness experience: a huge plus. You understand how to tell product stories credibly in a regulated category (claims, substantiation, FTC disclosures).

* You've launched or produced a podcast or YouTube series.

* Experience creating content for Amazon and retail, not just social.

**What Success Looks Like**

* First 30 days: You've audited every channel, shipped quick wins, raised posting cadence, and sent out the first new creator briefs.

* First 60 days: The content strategy and Onnit look-and-feel playbook are set. The inhouse engine ships daily across core platforms, and the performance scorecard and weekly review are running.

* First 90 days: Engagement, watch time and follower growth are measurably up. Athlete stories and creator content run on a steady rhythm, and the first recurring community series is live.

* First 6 months: Onnit content is instantly recognizable, the engine runs at high volume on a lean budget, and a podcast or YouTube series has launched.

**You'll** **Thrive Here If You**

* Would rather ship ten ideas this week than perfect one this quarter.

* Get energy from building something, not maintaining it.

* Check the comments before you check your email.

* Believe the best brands today behave like media companies.

* Want the freedom, and the accountability, that come with helping lead a brand's comeback.

**Benefits**

* Full medical, dental, and vision benefits
* Basic Life Insurance
* Immediate 401(k) eligibility with company matching
* Unlimited vacation
* Paid holidays
* Flexible workplace policy
* $100/month flexible benefit stipend
* Tuition reimbursement
* Fringe benefits include in-office meals, product credits and discounts, lifestyle spending account, family planning, online learning, fitness stipend, among many others

title: Creative Director - Growth / Experiential
description:
About Us:

**Who We Are**  
  
At Left Field Labs, we turn complex concepts, emerging technologies, and often ambiguous challenges into irresistible experiences people can see, touch, and understand. Experiential moments where abstract ideas become clear, irressistible, and tangible.

Our positioning is simple:

**We Make It Real.**

We’re looking for a Creative Director who can do exactly that shape bold ideas, tell the story that sells them, and lead — not dictate — teams to bring them to life.

Overview:

**THE WORK**

This role sits inside our GROWTH & NEXT Pods, working across some of the most ambitious and creatively open territory in the industry:

  

* Experiential environments — brand worlds, immersive spaces, permanent and touring installations
* Themed entertainment — narrative environments, attraction concepts, destination experiences
* Brand activations — moments that earn attention, build belief, and convert audiences into advocates
* Interactive and technology-enabled work — experiences where the audience participates, not just observes

You’ll lead creative across the full arc: from early pitch and concept development through to final execution. That means being as sharp in a competitive pitch room as you are on a build site walkthrough.

Responsibilities:

**HANDS-ON CRAFT**

This isn’t a role for someone who only directs from a distance.

We want someone who can get into the work — who can open a file, shape a frame, and contribute meaningfully to what’s on screen or in the room. Specifically, we’re looking for hands-on fluency in:

* **Graphic and/or digital design** — Visual systems, spatial graphics, concept visualization, motion
* **3D** — Environmental modeling, spatial concept development, real-time rendering

Both is exceptional. One is the floor. Either way, your hands-on capability should show up in how you direct, how you review, and how quickly you help a team find the right answer.

**THE QUESTION WE CARE ABOUT**

AI is everywhere.

Clients use it. Teams use it. Partners use it. So do we.

The real question isn’t whether you use AI — it’s how you use it to gain an advantage.

We want to understand:

  

* How AI expands your creative exploration
* How it helps you uncover insights others miss
* How it strengthens ideas instead of flattening them
* How it accelerates thinking without outsourcing judgment

In short: **How does AI make you a better Creative Director, not just a faster one? (or a lazier one.)**

  
Required Skills:

**TABLE STAKES**

There are fundamentals every Creative Director here must bring.

* + **Great Work** — A portfolio of ideas that live beyond the slide deck. Work that exists in environments, systems, installations, or interactions. Show us things that were actually built.
  + **Pitch Leadership** — You know how to shape and sell ideas in competitive environments. You understand what converts opportunity into business — and you can carry a room.
  + **Storytelling** — You craft narratives that capture attention, build belief, and move clients to act. From concept decks to client presentations, your work reads and performs.
  + **Team Leadership** — You elevate the people around you. Clear direction, strong taste, and the generosity to help others do their best work. Not a gatekeeper. A multiplier.
  + **Taste & Clarity of Vision** — You understand the difference between novelty and meaning, spectacle and substance. You push for both.

Qualifications:

**BACKGROUND & EXPERIENCE**

Experience across two or more of the following areas will set you apart:

* Experiential marketing and brand activations at scale
* Themed entertainment, attraction design, or narrative environment development
* Permanent or touring installations
* Technology-forward or interactive experience design
* Cultural moments; festivals, tentpoles, world’s fairs, fan experiences

We’re less interested in a single lane and more interested in someone who has genuine range and the creative ambition to push further in each direction.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $150,000-$200,000. This range is only applicable for jobs to be performed in Culver City, California. This is the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

description:
***We're on a mission to make money work for everyone.***

We're waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We're not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

London or Remote (UK) or Barcelona, Spain (Hybrid)

### **Engineering at Monzo**

Monzo has successfully launched in Ireland and is expanding across Europe. We're now entering the next phase of our journey: building and scaling a multi-market European bank.

The EU Engineering organisation sits at the centre of that ambition. We are responsible for helping Monzo launch, grow and operate across Europe, navigating everything from product-market fit and customer growth to regulatory requirements, localisation and operational scale.

Unlike most engineering organisations at Monzo, EU does not own a single product area. We work horizontally across the company, partnering with teams across Payments, Core Banking, Growth, Wealth, Customer Operations, Fincrime, Platform and many others to bring Monzo's products to new markets and deliver great customer experiences locally.

As an Engineering Director, you'll lead a distributed engineering organisation across the UK, Spain and remote locations. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Data, Operations, Risk, Compliance and executive stakeholders to solve complex problems that span organisational boundaries.

Success in this role comes through influence, relationships and organisational leadership as much as execution. You'll need to build alignment across a wide range of teams, create clarity in ambiguity, and help Monzo discover what works in new markets while establishing the foundations that allow us to scale across Europe.

This is one of Monzo's most strategically important areas and a unique opportunity to help build a European bank from the ground up.

**What you'll work on**

* Lead a distributed engineering organisation spanning multiple squads, markets and countries.
* Build and develop Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders.
* Partner with Product, Design, Data, Research, Operations, Risk and Compliance leaders to define and execute Monzo's European strategy.
* Drive alignment and execution across numerous collectives to ensure Europe receives the capabilities it needs to succeed.
* Shape how Monzo approaches market expansion, localisation, regulatory requirements and multi-market product development.
* Influence priorities and outcomes across teams that do not directly report to you.
* Create clarity and momentum in highly ambiguous problem spaces where ownership and solutions are not always obvious.
* Design and evolve organisational structures, operating models and planning processes that allow Monzo to scale effectively across Europe.
* Help identify and validate product-market fit in new markets while balancing short-term delivery and long-term strategic investments.
* Partner closely with executive leadership to shape the future of Monzo's European business.

### **You should apply if**

* You have experience leading large engineering organisations through other leaders, including Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior individual contributors.
* You have successfully operated in highly complex organisations where outcomes depend on collaboration across many teams and functions.
* You are exceptional at building relationships and influencing without direct authority.
* You can navigate ambiguity and create clarity where goals, ownership or priorities are not yet fully defined.
* You have experience scaling organisations through periods of rapid growth, organisational change or market expansion.
* You enjoy solving organisational and business problems, not just technical ones.You can balance strategy and execution, translating ambitious goals into tangible outcomes.
* You are comfortable making decisions in environments where there is rarely a perfect answer.
* You have a strong track record of building high-performing leadership teams and developing future leaders.
* You are energised by the challenge of building something new and helping shape the future of Monzo's international expansion.

### **The interview process**

After an informal ~30 min recruiter call our interview process involves 2 main stages:

* **Initial Call (1 hour)** You'll meet with one of our senior engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They'll ask example based questions ('Tell me about a time when…')

* **Loop Stage** - This is one stage with 4 interviews (totalling 4 hours) split between a collaboration with one of our engineers on a technical exercise, as well as execution and leadership interviews.

At all stages we'll create space for you to ask as many questions as you have, you're interviewing us as well!

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on tech-hiring@monzo.com. Please also use that email to let us know if there's anything we can do to make your application process easier for you, because of disability, neurodiversity or any other personal reason.

  

**How we work :**

**Locations & Flexible Working (If you're in the UK) :**

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles.

We value meeting in person but there's no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays ️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

**Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.**

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.

You'll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. ✨

Work the way that works for you with Monzo!

### **What's in it for you**

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK or Spain

✅ We can sponsor visas for the UK (not Spain)

This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

* We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

Learning budget of £1,000 ( a year for books, training courses and conferences

#LI-AL1 #LI-REMOTE

**Equal opportunities for everyone**

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we're making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we're embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

title: Senior Product Manager, AI Platform & Ecosystem
description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

**Our vision:** A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

### **About the Role:**

You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike's Work Intelligence Unit is building the foundation for a work delivery platform for humans and agents. MCP gives AI assistants secure, permission-aware access to Wrike, Skills help them use that access effectively and GraphQL provides a structured foundation for retrieving and acting on work data.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the product direction for Wrike's AI Platform & Ecosystem, including MCP, Skills and GraphQL. You will make Wrike easier for AI assistants and agents to understand, use and extend.

This is a platform role with broad leverage. You will lead the core MCP team, help other Wrike teams create their own MCP tools and Skills where they hold domain expertise and give the GraphQL engineering team clear product direction on how its capabilities and tools should evolve. You will also own the publishing and ongoing quality of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant AI marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.

**Role Scope:**

You will own the strategy and roadmap for Wrike's agent-facing platform, working closely with the core MCP and GraphQL engineering teams complemented by Architecture, Security, customer-facing and product teams across Wrike.

**MCP, Skills and GraphQL Strategy:**

* Lead the core MCP team and define the roadmap for how external AI assistants and agents securely interact with Wrike.
* Define MCP standards and enable other Wrike teams to create high-quality tools for the domains where they have expertise.
* Lead the discovery and creation of Skills that help agents and AI assistants use Wrike effectively, while establishing standards that other teams can follow.
* Set the product direction for GraphQL and the tools built on top of it, ensuring its evolution improves the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core.

**Ecosystem, Quality and Distribution:**

* Own the publishing, maintenance and evolution of the Wrike MCP plugin across relevant marketplaces, including OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft.
* Create a clear approach to MCP quality, reliability, governance, documentation and developer experience.
* Work with customers, partners and internal teams to identify the highest-value agent workflows and improve them through feedback and usage data.
* Translate technical trade-offs into clear product decisions; hands-on coding is not required.

**What You Will Help Shape:**

* A scalable MCP and Skills ecosystem that lets AI assistants and agents securely understand and act on work in Wrike, while enabling Wrike teams to contribute their domain expertise.
* GraphQL capabilities and tools that broaden the coverage and usefulness of Wrike Core for MCP, Skills, and future agent experiences.
* A strong marketplace presence and high-quality plugin experience across the AI assistants where customers want to use Wrike.

### **Your Impact:**

* Make Wrike a trusted, useful system of action for AI assistants and agents working across customers' existing ecosystems.
* Give customers reliable, permission-aware ways to let AI assistants retrieve context and take action in Wrike.
* Turn customer needs, ecosystem signals and technical constraints into a focused roadmap for MCP, Skills and GraphQL.
* Enable other teams across Wrike to contribute agent-ready tools and Skills while maintaining shared standards for quality and governance.

### **Your Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of PM experience in technical, platform, AI, developer, or enterprise software.
* Experience with MCP and Skills, including how agents use tools and guidance to act effectively.
* Technical fluency in AI agents, MCP, Skills, permissions, reliability, and developer experience; hands-on engineering is not required. GraphQL experience and an understanding of structured product data is a major advantage.
* Use customer research, adoption data, experiments, and feedback to set priorities and improve outcomes.
* Explain complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.
* Proactive and can-do: take ownership, solve problems, and adapt as you learn.

**Why This Role Is Unique:**

* You will help define how Wrike becomes a trusted platform for AI assistants and agents, not just a destination where work is stored.
* You will work at the intersection of agentic AI, developer experience, enterprise permissions, platform strategy and customer value.
* The role is remote across the European Union, with a preference for Prague, Czech Republic and Cyprus.

### **What's Next?**

* Introduction Call with a Recruiter

* Conversation with the AI Product Director

* Interview with Product and Engineering, Architecture representatives

* Final interview with CPO and HRBP

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.  
  
#LI-AV1

### **Who Is Wrike and Our Culture**

We're a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

**Hybrid work mode**

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.

While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

#### **Our persona**

**Smart:** We love what we do, and we're great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.

**Dedicated:** We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We're committed to helping our teammates win, too!

**Approachable:** We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

#### **Our culture and Values**

**Customer-Focused**

**We care about our customers.** We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

**Collaborative**

**We work as one and win together,** each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

**Creative**

**We strive to succeed through continuous innovation.** It's our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

**Committed**

**We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization,** by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

title: Editor, Marketing
description:
**About Darkroom**

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it.

Darkroom is a progressive omnichannel growth marketing agency focused on retail, e-commerce, and consumer businesses. We have been recognized as one of the fastest growing private companies in America by Inc. 5000 (2023), a top 1% digital advertiser by Varos (2023), and our founders were named Forbes 30 Under 30 recipients for Marketing and Advertising North America (2024).

As a Video Editor on Darkroom’s internal Marketing Team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the visual storytelling behind our brand. You'll work closely with our Video Lead, Design Lead, and Director to transform raw content into engaging, high-impact videos for platforms like Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and LinkedIn. This is a fast-moving, creative, and collaborative role for someone with sharp instincts, strong technical skills, and a passion for crafting content that connects with audiences.

In this role, you’ll develop a scalable, high-output video content engine that fuels Darkroom’s brand voice. You’ll design a creative system for rapid, high-quality production across channels, repurposing standout moments from podcasts, events, and behind-the-scenes footage. With a performance-driven approach to storytelling, you’ll adapt quickly to platform shifts, experiment with new formats, and continuously refine output based on real-world results.

**This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.**

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**Social-First Video Editing**

* Edit and produce standout content across short-form (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) and long-form (YouTube, webinars).
* Create native video formats optimized for IG, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, and X, including repurposed edits and cutdowns.
* Build scroll-stopping hooks, apply text overlays, closed captions, sound design, and motion graphics that support performance.
* Turn voice notes, podcasts, webinars and interviews into polished, platform-native video content.
* Surface and extract the most compelling moments from raw footage: podcast soundbites, behind-the-scenes gems, founder tangents, interviews, etc.
* Collaborate with the Video Lead on edits, structure, and narrative framing.
* Organize, tag, and manage footage to create a systemized pipeline for recurring content formats.
* Understand performance data and collaborate with the marketing team to refine editing strategies based on what drives reach, engagement, and conversion.
* Test hooks, variations and formats to optimize output over time.
* Stay ahead of editing trends and platform algorithm shifts.

### **Production Excellence**

* Apply finishing touches: color correction, transitions, graphics, and text effects that align with the Darkroom brand language.
* Deliver content in multiple aspect ratios and formats for cross-platform distribution.
* Maintain high audio fidelity, visual clarity, and consistent branding across deliverables.
* Proactively troubleshoot creative or technical challenges and recommend solutions.
* Support post-production for Darkroom’s podcast and event recordings.
* Add intros/outros, audio enhancements, and accessible subtitles.

**You’re a Great Fit If You:**
------------------------------

* Have 3-4+ years of experience editing content for social-first brands, creators, or agencies.
* Know your way around Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, and have working knowledge of After Effects, Photoshop and motion graphics.
* Have a sharp eye for storytelling, pacing, and rhythm, and you know how to build content that keeps attention.
* Understand editing for performance, not just aesthetics. You know what performs on TikTok vs. YT Shorts vs. LinkedIn.
* Are fluent in optimizing content across multiple aspect ratios and formats.
* Can own your edit from concept to final export while staying collaborative, communicative, and open to feedback.
* Thrive in fast-paced, feedback-rich environments where no two days (or edits) are the same.
* Are organized, meticulous, and always ready with a plan B (or C).

### **Bonus Points If You:**

* Have experience editing founder-led content or personal brand material.
* Have worked on performance-driven or growth marketing creative.
* Use AI tools (Descript, Runway, etc.) for cutdowns, transcription, or speeding up your workflow.

**What it's like to work at Darkroom**

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:

* Unlimited Vacation Policy and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.
* Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!
* Finances, growth, and retirement: Equity incentives, and a profit-sharing opportunity so we can help you save as the company grows.
* Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.
* Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

**This role is currently a Talent Pool, which means we are not actively interviewing — but plan to do so in the near future. We want to be transparent and cognizant of your time.**

### **Equal Opportunity Statement**

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements

title: Head of People
description:
Founded in 2019, Qualifyze is a leading company in supply chain compliance management in the Life Sciences industry, trusted by over 1,600 pharmaceutical and healthcare companies globally. Our digital suite of solutions connects manufacturers, suppliers, and a global network of more than 250 auditors and quality experts.

With a track record of over 4,500 audits across 85+ countries and the largest and most accurate supplier network and data analytics tools, Qualifyze stands as the all-in-one partner for quality compliance and supply chain risk mitigation in the Life Sciences sector.

We are looking for a **Head of People** who will own the **operational infrastructure** that lets Qualifyze **hire, pay, develop, and retain people effectively**: Talent Acquisition, People Operations, Performance Management, Payroll, Compensation & Benefits Administration, and Compliance. Reporting directly to the SVP of Finance, you are the backbone of the People function.

**You'll have end-to-end ownership.** Every area below is yours, from design through execution to results. You don't hand work off and step back. When something breaks, you fix it, then fix the process behind it

You'll **shape the team**, hire into new roles, and set the standards the People function runs on.

#### **Main responsibilities:**

* **Leading and developing a high-impact team:**
  + You'll lead a lean, pragmatic team across People Operations, Talent Acquisition, and Business Partnering, setting clear priorities and performance expectations while carrying your own operational workload.
  + You'll coach each team member through regular 1:1s, reviews, and growth plans, building a team that becomes a trusted advisor to managers and business leaders as the business scales, hiring into open roles, and putting shared processes in place so delivery stays consistent across every location.
* **Driving end-to-end hiring & Employer Branding initiatives:**
  + You’ll deliver the hiring plan across all entities, owning the full recruitment process from sourcing and interviews to hiring manager enablement and offer management, while strengthening our employer brand to attract the talent we need.
  + You bring a data-driven mindset, tracking and acting on metrics such as time-to-hire, pipeline health, and source effectiveness to set priorities.
* **Building scalable People Operations & HR Systems:**
  + Own and continuously improve Personio and end-to-end People Operations across our entities ensuring accurate, compliant, and scalable processes throughout the employee journey.
  + Oversee accurate and timely payroll across all entities and jurisdictions, in collaboration with Accounting and external partners, while managing benefits administration and vendor relationships.
  + Drive operational excellence through automation, self-service, and AI-enabled solutions that improve the employee and manager experience, focusing on outcomes rather than activity.
  + Ensure compliance with local labour laws, maintain employment policies, contracts, and the employee handbook, and handle employee relations cases in partnership with legal counsel.
* **Driving our rewards policy & high-impact performance:**
  + Own compensation reviews, promotions, compensation ranges, and progression frameworks, ensuring fair and consistent outcomes.
  + Maintain compliance with EU Pay Transparency requirements and related audits and reporting.
  + Lead the performance review cycle across all entities, including manager enablement, calibration, and consistent, well-documented outcomes.
  + Design and continuously improve performance frameworks, ensuring successful rollout and adoption.
* **Workforce Planning & Organisational Effectiveness:**
  + Partner directly with Finance to build and maintain workforce planning models, budget-to-actuals tracking, and headcount reporting.
  + Provide the data and process rigour needed to support organisational design and restructuring decisions.
* **Creating and Engaging Workplace & Culture:**
  + Ensure the smooth running of our offices in Frankfurt, New Jersey, Hyderabad, and Barcelona, creating environments that support productivity, community, and employee well-being.
  + Lead culture and key company initiatives, including global and local office events.

#### **Main requirements:**

* 7+ years in people, HR, or shared services roles, with direct, hands-on ownership of talent acquisition, performance management, payroll, HRIS, and compliance.
* Experience in high-change environments. Multi-country and multi-entity experience is a strong plus.
* Comfortable managing complexity across multiple jurisdictions. Practical experience with Spanish and/or German labor law is a strong plus.
* A track record of personally owning the operational execution of people processes at scale, and of managing teams across multiple locations.
* Tech-savvy with a mindset for adopting AI, automation, and process optimization.
* Fluent English is required. Spanish and/or German are a plus.
* An organized, structured thinker with a pragmatic approach to finding solutions in a fast-paced environment.

#### **Salary:**

At Qualifyze, our salary ranges are transparent internally, and we aim to follow a similar approach externally. For this role, we’re happy to share a reference point within the band: the expected salary range is around **80,000 - 85,000 €**, centred around the median.

Final compensation will depend on experience and performance during the process, with some flexibility within the range.

#### **What We Offer:**

* Competitive, annually reviewed compensation package
* Country vacation package that increases with your tenure
* ️ Country specific benefits offering incl.private health care, fitness and meal allowances
* Annual personal development budget to increase your impact
* Hybrid working mode, plus up to 3 months of the year work from anywhere.
* All the best kit and tools to work effectively
* Annual in person all company event and celebration in Europe
* Working with an exceptional team, doing some of the best work of your career

#### **Use of AI in Our Recruitment Process:**

We believe in a humanled hiring process. All applications are reviewed manually by our Talent Acquisition team, and neither Talent Acquisition nor Hiring Managers use AI to screen, filter, rank, assess, or make decisions about candidates, including during interviews and assessments. During interviews, AI may be used only to support note-taking and transcription. All hiring decisions are made by people!

#### **Diversity & Inclusion at Qualifyze:**

At Qualifyze, we value diversity and inclusion, recognizing the strength that complementary talents and perspectives bring to our team. Join us and help drive innovation, tackle challenges, and create meaningful change. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, disability, or age. Our hiring practices are rooted in fairness and respect, and we strive to create a culture where everyone feels valued and empowered.

We are building a more accessible, more impactful model of higher education. We are a fast-growing, mission-driven organisation creating transformational global experiences.

**✨ About the Role**

Successful candidates will be highly motivated, energetic, student-oriented educators who bring courses to life for students through a combination of active classroom learning and experiential education. Faculty must possess a commitment to undergraduate teaching and experiential education, and be prepared to work with diverse students early in their higher education journey.

Deeply engaged learning is a key element of teaching. Faculty must be willing to help students develop necessary academic skills and build their academic identity as a new college student, alongside teaching disciplinary content. Faculty work with program staff to embed active and experiential activities into the course and will teach in traditional face to face classroom settings as well as taking students into the community. Verto’s academic team provides ongoing faculty training and support, offers regular feedback and coaching, and offers access to a wide variety of teaching and professional development resources and course/student support structures. Verto academic staff work closely with faculty to ensure unity across instructors and courses for continuity in delivering high-quality teaching and learning experiences across Verto program locations. Faculty are encouraged to collaborate with peers in their disciplines across the global Verto network.

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**

Faculty are responsible for teaching and creating an inclusive learning environment for all participants, and for following the established teaching methodologies and expectations of Verto, its Academic Provider, and other stakeholders. Faculty design courses utilizing the provided syllabi and supporting resources, including LMS and online textbooks. Faculty implement academic policies and coursework in compliance with academic requirements established with Verto’s Academic Provider(s). This includes, but is not limited to:

* Develop and deliver course(s) utilizing the provided academic policies, course syllabi and LMS (Canvas) and textbook resources, templates and timelines.
* Adhere to all local and global faculty and course requirements including delievery of all expected contact hours and adherence to teaching schedule and curriculum.
* Faculty must demonstrate appropriate conduct and treat all students, faculty and staff with respect to create an inclusive environment.
* Develop relevant, discipline-based, up-to-date course content and applied learning experiences. Willingness to advance curricular experimentation, particularly related to active and experiential learning, student development, learning assessment (e.g. rubrics) and technology (e.g. AI, Canvas) and following established best practices for curriculum development and openness to feedback is important.
* Evaluate students’ homework and provide regular and formative feedback, and score student work in a timely and constructive manner. Assess student mastery of Course Objectives and Student Learning Outcomes in your course(s).
* New faculty are expected to participate in up to ten hours of faculty training & development every semester prior to program start date and an additional five hours of ongoing professional development throughout the semester. Attend regular faculty meetings (1x1 and group) throughout the semester. Returning faculty are expected to contribute to ongoing faculty development and may be asked to share good practices, lead training, conduct course observations and/ or mentor peer / new faculty or contribute to course-specific projects.
* Teach all scheduled courses and host weekly office hours, respond in a timely, specified manner to student inquiries. Communicate promptly with local academic staff in the event of emergencies.
* Champion student success by holistic student support, monitoring student attendance & monitor student engagement, communicating care and concern requests to academic staff. Diligently meet the specific, documented ongoing needs of students with academic accommodations. Refer students to appropriate learning support services and interventions.
* Educate participants and enforce policies on Attendance and Academic Integrity, and proactively and professionally address any related grading questions, concerns or appeals with students directly, consulting with local academic staff as needed.
* Follow established academic calendar(s), relevant parts of term and grading progress and policies, and maintain highly accurate academic records related to student enrollments, attendance and academic performance.
