You make sure to align with local regulations and brand expectations, you guarantee the peace of mind for residents.

* **Create meaningful local connections & bring the community to life.**

You act as an ambassador of the residence within Madrid, you curate exclusive local partnerships and bespoke lifestyle offerings to enrich residents everyday living, foster connection, and express the unique energy of SLS living.

 **Qualifications**

**What you’ll bring to**

* 7–10 years of progressive **leadership experience** within ultra-luxury standalone residences, high-end residential environments, serviced apartments, or private members’ clubs.
* A proven ability to **deliver elevated, intuitive and highly personalized service**, with a strong track record of building trusted relationships with high-net-worth homeowners and residents.
* **Strong financial acumen**, with experience managing budgets, forecasting performance, optimizing resources and driving operational excellence within a luxury environment.
* **Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills**, with the presence, confidence and emotional intelligence to engage effortlessly with homeowners, teams, partners and executive stakeholders.
* A **natural leader** with a demonstrated ability to inspire, develop and unite cross-functional teams in a dynamic, detail-driven and service-focused setting.
* Strong command of property management systems, CRM platforms and Microsoft Office, with the agility to navigate both operational detail and strategic oversight.

title: Social Media Lead - SportyTV & Sports Media Brands
description:
**About Sporty Group**
----------------------

Sporty Group is a global sports entertainment company, home to leading brands like **SportyBet**, **Football.com** and **SportyTV**. We operate at the intersection of **sports, content, community and technology**, building products and media experiences that connect fans with the moments that matter.

Our media brands, led by **SportyTV**, bring fans closer to the game through highlights, stories, analysis, personalities and football culture, across every major social platform.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We're looking for a **Social Media Lead** to drive social strategy and coordinate the social team behind **SportyTV and our sports media brands**. This role combines **team leadership**, a **sports journalism mindset** and **strong editorial judgement** to make our channels a go-to destination for football fans.

You'll set the editorial direction, run day-to-day publishing operations, and lead a team of social media managers, community managers and content creators, making sure our output is **fast, accurate, engaging and built for growth**.

You'll work closely with **Content, Video/Production, Design, Brand, Marketing, Partnerships, BI and Country teams**, and report to the Social Media Director.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Team Leadership & Coordination**

* Lead, coordinate and develop a team of social media managers, community managers and content creators across SportyTV and our media brands.
* Set priorities, assign coverage and run workflows and shift planning for match days, live events and breaking news.
* Give clear feedback, run regular editorial meetings and raise the team's creative and editorial standards.
* Build scalable processes (calendars, briefs, approval flows, playbooks) that keep the team fast and consistent.

### **Editorial Strategy & Sports Coverage**

* Define and execute the social and editorial strategy for **SportyTV and Football.com**, aligned with global brand guidelines and business priorities.
* Own the editorial calendar around major football and sports moments (EPL, UCL, LaLiga, AFCON, World Cup, transfer windows, etc.).
* Apply a journalistic approach to social: newsworthiness, storytelling, fact-checking, source verification and speed without sacrificing accuracy.
* Lead real-time and reactive coverage of match days, breaking news, transfers, controversies and trending moments.

### **Content & Formats**

* Oversee content across Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, YouTube (incl. Shorts), LinkedIn and Telegram.
* Develop and scale repeatable content series and franchises: highlights-led narratives, analysis, interviews, explainers, football culture and personality-led formats.
* Work with video, production and design teams to deliver platform-native content with strong hooks and retention.
* Ensure tone of voice, quality and brand consistency across all channels.

### **Community & Audience Growth**

* Drive follower growth, engagement and watch time across SportyTV and media brand channels.
* Oversee community management: comments, DMs, moderation, sentiment monitoring and escalation of sensitive issues.
* Spot local relevance opportunities across our key markets and global football audiences.

### **Talent, Creators & Partnerships**

* Work with presenters, journalists, pundits, creators and sports personalities to grow reach and credibility.
* Support partnerships, rights-holder relationships and co-branded activations with clubs, leagues and media partners.
* Coordinate with marketing teams on organic and paid amplification.

### **Reporting & Performance**

* Track KPIs: reach, views, watch time, engagement, follower growth, retention and sentiment.
* Deliver weekly/monthly reporting with clear insights and next actions for the team and leadership.
* Run testing frameworks to improve formats, hooks, timing and distribution.

**Requirements**
----------------

* **5+ years** of experience in social media, with at least **2 years coordinating or leading social media teams**.
* Background in **sports journalism, sports media or a sports newsroom** (degree in Journalism or Communications is a plus).
* Proven experience running social channels for **sports media brands, publishers, broadcasters, clubs or leagues**.
* Deep football and sports knowledge, with a strong news sense and love for the game.
* **Excellent English (C1/C2 or native)**: you'll write, edit and approve content in English and it's our main working language. Spanish or other languages are a plus.
* Strong editorial judgement: accuracy, fact-checking, tone and handling sensitive stories.
* Excellent platform instincts across TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube and Facebook, and a good understanding of video-first content.
* Confident using analytics and social listening tools to guide decisions.
* Strong organisation, stakeholder management and the ability to lead a team in a fast-paced, high-output environment.

### **Nice to have**

* Experience with live coverage of major tournaments.
* Experience working with audiences in Africa, Latin America or other international markets.
* Hands-on video editing or production experience.

If you're interested, we encourage you to apply! Every application is reviewed by a member of our team (AI is not used in our recruitment process), and we aim to respond within 48 hours.

title: Regional People Partner - Europe Major Markets
description:
### **Description**

**Diversity matters**

We are building a brand that represents the people of the world. It’s what you do that counts, and we are always looking to expand perspectives and voices to shape our future.

We see you, we celebrate you, we want you!

**Who we are**  
You might know us as the inventors of the bath bomb, but there’s more to this great-smelling, partly employee-owned, family-run company than pioneering cosmetics. We believe our business should put more back into the world than it takes and demonstrate that capitalism can be a force for good.  
  
The Living Wage Foundation’s statement 'a hard day's work deserves a fair day's pay' is one that we are proud to commit to in the UK. As an accredited Living Wage employer, we put our people first and fight cruel practices like animal testing, promote regeneration, and show that it is what’s inside that counts - whether that’s an ingredient in a product, or the minerals in a smartphone.  
  
Want to see where a career at Lush could take you? Head over here to explore real stories of growth and development across the business.  
  
Lush is committed to pay transparency and equal pay for equal work or work of equal value. Pay decisions are made objectively based on role scope, geographic market data, experience, and capability, without regard to gender or protected characteristics.  
  
**Role overview:**

Develop meaningful and mutually beneficial relationships between people practices and commercial business success across our European major markets. Engage with regional leaders, country managers, and business partners. Deliver change and transformation, taking the lead in people related projects with a broad and objective view of the impact across diverse business areas and geographies within the region.

This role involves direct line management and leadership of People Leads across our European entities. Driving regional alignment, operational consistency, and team development. You will utilise sound knowledge of Lush people principles and best practices, working collaboratively and proactively with other members of the global and regional people team on cross functional projects, in support of colleagues doing their best work across multiple markets.

**Office Location:** This role will support our colleagues in France, Germany, Italy and Spain and ideally you're main location of work will be Paris, Berlin, Milan or Madrid.

**Business Travel:** As this role will be supporting France, Germany, Italy and Spain, travelling will be a requirement.  
  
**Please note: We may close this vacancy early if we receive an overwhelming response or our business requirements change.**

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Directly line manage and empower the People Leads across European entities, fostering their growth, setting clear operational standards, and ensuring strong local HR delivery.
* Work alongside the Leader/Director, FBP, and their team on a wide range of topics, such as change management, projects, organisational design, recruitment, training and development, and communications.
* Provide tactical advice and guidance to the management of your business areas on all people matters relating to capability, skills required, and performance output.
* Connect regularly with the People Discipline Leads creating alignment in standards of staff experience in recruitment, onboarding, training, pay, and development while respecting and adapting to local cultural and regulatory nuances within the region.
* Deliver organisational development projects and support organisational change initiatives within the business entities. Establishing needs, proposing solutions, and monitoring effectiveness to get the best possible return for the business area while managing regional complexity and local implementation.
* Navigate local employment law landscapes across major markets, partnering with local experts and employee representative bodies such as Works Councils and Trade Unions to ensure fair, compliant, and culturally sensitive operations.
* Build relationships of mutual learning and trust with regional peers and stakeholders and have a good understanding of individuals' working styles and team dynamics.
* Assess and review team structures & development pathways. Identify skills gaps, succession planning, talent, and performance management opportunities across your team and European entities.
* Clearly communicate guidance to staff at all levels on change management and restructures, with emphasis on the how, ensuring compliance with all relevant jurisdictional requirements by working with local experts.
* Proactively anticipate issues before they happen and act for prevention, particularly regarding cross border people movement and regulatory changes across European markets.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* Minimum of 5 years of HR/People Partnering experience, ideally within a multi site retail, commercial, or multinational environment.
* Proven track record in line managing, coaching, and developing HR/People leads across international or multi entity business models.
* Broad understanding of the commercial landscape within Europe with a drive to help others understand it too.
* Solid working knowledge of French employment law is highly beneficial. Familiarity with employment law in other key European markets is desirable, though core knowledge across other jurisdictions can be taught and supported by local specialists.
* Experience in, or strong capability to navigate:
  + Works Councils (Comité Social et Économique / Betriebsrat) in France and Germany.
  + Trade Unions & Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBA / CCN) in Spain and Italy (e.g., *Convenio Colectivo*, *Contratto Collettivo Nazionale di Lavoro*).
* Trusted relationship with the Director/s, with a track record of providing useful advice and recommendations on people matters.
* Act with kindness, integrity, and respect.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to make decisions independently.
* Informed, relevant, and up to date with the business and team sentiment across the region.
* High emotional intelligence with the ability to think quickly and sensitively in a culturally diverse environment.
* Demonstrable ability to influence, challenge, and negotiate with management at all levels and execute with excellence.
* Excellent ability to navigate multiple perspectives and stakeholders to deliver action that works for everyone.
* Desire to represent a professional and fair approach.
* Strong ability to constantly assess and prioritise the needs of the business and individuals.
* Positive attitude, motivated, action oriented.
* Able to support the growth and development of individuals at all levels.
* Competent in recruiting, interviewing, career conversations in addition to performance management, sensitive feedback, or exit conversations.
* Commercially minded, analytical, and objective, with a strong grasp of regional market data and trends.
* Collaborate closely with other People disciplines to ensure support for all employees, including Talent, Global Mobility, Pay and Benefits, ED&I, People Support, and L&D.

**Languages**

* Professional fluency in spoken and written English is required.
* Professional fluency in one or more major European languages (French, German, Spanish, or Italian) is strongly preferred to effectively manage localised People Leads and partner with regional stakeholders across key entities.

  

### **Benefits**

  

* Bonus scheme
* Day off for weekday birthdays
* A generous discount on Lush products and spa treatments
* Employee assistance programme
* We’re 10% Employee Owned - all colleagues play a role in protecting our ethics, our independence, contributing ideas for the future and share in the rewards of success when the company is doing well.
* Access to employee-led Community Networks, including Disability and Chronic Illness, Family Support, Global Majority (Race and Ethnicity), LGBTQIA+, Menopause and Neurodiversity communities.

Localised benefits can be discussed in more detail during the recruitment process.

We believe that your information is yours and that it is Lush's responsibility to process your personal information in a secure, fair and accurate manner. Every individual processed by LUSH has certain rights over their data, which are detailed in our Privacy Notice here.

### **About Lush**

Since establishing in 1995 in Poole, Dorset, Lush has been driven by innovation and its ethics.  
Creators of pioneering beauty products such as the fizzing bath bomb, shower jellies and solid shampoo bars, we place emphasis on fresh ingredients like organic fruits and vegetables, fight against animal testing and combat over-packaging by developing products that can be sold ‘naked’ to the customer without any packaging.  
  
We currently operate in 52 countries with 928 global shops. Through our separate business divisions we invent, manufacture and sell our handmade products direct to our customers through our own shops and online. The fact that we make all our products by hand is something we are really rather proud of!  
  
Lush is 10% Employee Owned since 2017 and our people are the heart and soul of our business.

description:

Alcântara, PRT, 1300‑001, | Gentofte, DNK, 2820,

**Manager, Strategy & Execution**

* **Location:** Copenhagen / Lisbon
* **Work model:** Hybrid / Full time

Do you want to lead projects that influence the future direction of global business? Are you curious about how to keep a strategy alive across a global organization? Are you excited by working closely with experienced leaders to solve the most challenging problems in our business? Then you might be who we are looking for!

You will be part of our Strategy & Execution team and work on high-impact, cross-functional projects that help drive STG's strategy forward. You will work directly with the Head of Strategy and the rest of the team, partnering closely with business leaders and subject matter experts across the organization. You can expect to spend your time both supporting the Executive Board decision-making, and working with the business to drive execution. Your contributions will drive strategic initiatives, bring new clarity to complex problems, align stakeholders through challenging trade-offs and ultimately help STG deliver our strategic ambitions. Our team are the stewards of the Focus2030 strategy, and you will play a core part in keeping the strategy alive in the business while remaining responsive to market changes and execution learnings.

This would be an ideal role for an associate-manager level consultant looking to transition into a corporate role so they can take longer term ownership of their projects and see them come to life.

  

**What your day will look like**

As a Manager in the Strategy & Execution team, you can expect to work across a wide range of projects and initiatives. Example projects could include:

* Preparing materials for the Board of Directors strategy days
* Developing a methodology to define future market roles
* Building a business case to optimise our product portfolio to maximise growth and operational efficiency
* Supporting a business team to prioritise their focus areas for the strategy period
* Reviewing our progress to delivering our strategy for the Exec Board
* Creating a new Exec Board KPI dashboard to continuously monitor the success of strategy execution
* Developing a comms plan for Focus2030

Your role will vary from developing content yourself to collaborating closely with others, depending on the project or business needs. Your role will often include:

* Project managing complex, cross-functional projects
* Creating insightful analysis (gathering, testing, combining, summarising, visualising)
* Developing frameworks to bring simplicity and clarity to complex problems and decisions
* Working closely with experts and stakeholders to identify and refine recommendations
* Running workshops with senior leaders
* Building slide decks to tell a compelling message
* Managing and supporting the development of more junior team member(s)
  

**What you’ll bring**

* You will bring a minimum of 3-4 years of strategy and/or management consulting experience
  + Experience in a corporate environment (permanent or secondments) is a plus
* Problem and decision structuring – experience building frameworks to simplify challenges and decisions to enable the business to move forward
* Experience in Consumer-Packaged Goods and/or Retail sectors
* Demonstrated project management experience and attention to detail
* Strong stakeholder management and team working experience
* Demonstrated strong analytical skills including experience delivering complex analyses in Excel
  + Understanding P&L / key accounting principles / Cashflow modelling is a plus
  + Understanding of data structuring principles and leveraging multiple data sources a plus
* Good slide development skills (storyboarding, content development, polishing) for C-level messaging
* A learning and growth mindset – developing yourself and supporting the development of the team around you
* Experience and curiosity in using GenAi tools to accelerate and improve your work, including effective prompting, iterative refinement and critical evaluation of AI outputs
* Professionally fluent in English
  

**What you’ll learn**

* There will be a strong investment in your development where you need it, with a variety of experiences and supportive coaching
* This could include:
  + Deepening your experience in the CPG / Retail sector
  + Refining your presentation skills, to communicate complex topics in a clear and effective way
  + Leading projects that are critical to our strategy success
  + Strengthening your stakeholder management skills in a complex, cross-functional, international organization
* This role will give exposure to senior leaders across business globally and equip you to be a transformation leader with extensive experience working alongside C-suite
* Our Strategy department, which brings together teams focused on strategy execution, consumer insights, business intelligence, data, and sustainability, will provide you with an opportunity to broaden your expertise across these disciplines too
  

**Working at STG & What to expect**

At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next. At STG you'll find more than a role—you'll find opportunities to grow, collaborate across borders, and make a meaningful impact. Our Strategy team brings together over 15 nationalities and 20 languages, for a culturally rich and diverse environment.

We work flexibly and understand the importance of balancing work with your personal life. At the same time, collaboration is a key part of how we work, so you can expect to be in our office in Gentofte or Alcantra at least 3 days per week.

**Our recruitment process**

Before starting our hiring process, your application will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We assess each application against key competencies and requirements for the role. If your experience and skills are a good match, you'll be invited to continue through our hiring process, which will likely follow the following steps:

* Recruiter Screen

* Team Interview

* Behavioural Assessment

* Leadership Interview with case study

Ready to be part of something bigger? Apply now and discover **so much more.**

Scandinavian Tobacco Group is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

**“Please be informed that this Direct Search is conducted exclusively by Scandinavian Tobacco Group. We do not accept applications from agencies, and we will not provide compensation for unsolicited CVs.”**

* Drive an exceptional candidate experience throughout every stage of the recruitment journey.
* Coordinate and facilitate recruitment events, career fairs, assessment centers, and open days.

* Analyze recruitment metrics and market trends to continuously improve hiring effectiveness and efficiency.

* Partner with the People Culture team to ensure seamless onboarding and integration of new employees.

* Strong experience sourcing talent across a variety of functions and levels, including management and operational roles.
* Demonstrated ability to build talent pipelines, employer branding initiatives, and recruitment partnerships.
* Fluent in English, with excellent communication skills and proficiency in applicant tracking systems, HR technology, and Microsoft Office.

**Key Competencies**

* Passion for identifying and attracting exceptional talent.
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and interviewing capabilities.
* Proactive, results-driven, and highly organized approach.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
* Alignment with ZEST values, culture, and service philosophy.

**Benefits**

At ZEST, we believe that exceptional employee experiences create exceptional guest experiences. As Talent Acquisition Manager, you will play a fundamental role in building the team that will define our culture and guest experience from day one.

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunities for professional growth, learning, and career development.
* Be part of a pre-opening team and help build the resort's workforce from the ground up.
* Access to training and development programs designed to enhance your leadership and recruitment expertise.
* Employee recognition and engagement initiatives that celebrate success and performance.
* The opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a company committed to innovation, service excellence, and people development.
* Work within a culture driven by the ZEST Effect, where passion, collaboration, and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do.

**Why Join Us?**

This is more than a recruitment role. It is an opportunity to shape the future of ZEST by identifying, attracting, and hiring the people who will create extraordinary experiences for our guests and colleagues. If you are passionate about talent, hospitality, and building exceptional teams, we would love to hear from you.

**Department:** Global Clinical Affairs & Education, Southern European Hub  
**Location:** Madrid, Paris or Milan  
**Reports To:** Global Head of Clinical Affairs & Education, Clear Correct

**Job Summary:**  
The Training & Education (T&E) Manager plays a pivotal role in driving the adoption and success of ClearCorrect through impactful education initiatives. This role balances strategic cross-team activities with operational excellence, ensuring Southern European Hub education programs are aligned with global strategy while tailored to the local market needs. The position is critical to building credibility with healthcare professionals, accelerating clinical adoption, and positioning ClearCorrect as the partner of choice.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Education Strategy & Programs**  

* Serve as the regional education strategist, translating the Hub market insights into global program design and priorities.
* Act as a thought partner to Global Education team, shaping long-term education strategies, KPIs, and investment decisions.
* Drive innovation by introducing and piloting new digital education formats (microlearning, AI-powered learning, gamification, hybrid workshops).
* Work closely with Sales leadership to embed education into commercial strategy, equipping the field force with learning tools to drive utilization.
* Define and track key education KPIs (learner outcomes, adoption impact, program ROI).
* Use CRM and analytics tools to demonstrate the value of education to leadership and commercial teams.
* Collaborate with Marketing to integrate education into campaigns and amplify reach across multiple channels.
* Partner with Clinical Research and R&D&I to translate innovations into education content for customers.
* Coordinate and deliver best-in-class local education events, webinars, and workshops, ensuring operational excellence and brand consistency.
* Partner with Global T&E to ensure curriculum consistency and scalability across regions.
* Lead post-event measurement and impact reporting to track ROI and influence business growth.

**Key Customer & KOL Engagement**  

* Build and manage strong relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), ensuring alignment with global strategy while addressing local needs.
* Support the creation of advisory boards with KOLs and speakers to shape future education programs.
* Expand partnerships with universities, dental schools, and professional associations to strengthen market influence.
* Act as a regional ambassador for global education initiatives, driving adoption and alignment across North America.
* Mentor and support regional team members, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation in education delivery.
* Champion changes by advocating for global standards, while tailoring execution to regional realities.

**Minimal Qualifications**  

* Associate or Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field of work or an equivalent combination of dentistry, training education, or product management with work-related experience
* 4+ years’ work experience in oral health education industries.
* Track record in achieving challenging results.
* Good knowledge of computer operations and Microsoft Office tools.
* Language: English (Fluent) and Spanish (Fluent), French or Italian (Preferred).
* Expected travel 40%.

**Personal attributes & cultural fit**  

* Energetic, straightforward, and performance-driven professionality with entrepreneurial spirit and strong marketing and commercial execution abilities.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a matrix environment.
* Strong presentation and communication skills.
* Ability to celebrate successes and inspire a motivational team environment.
* Effective relationship builder.
* Enthusiastic about providing excellent support & service, always customer centric.

*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.*

title: Head of Sourcing
description:
HBX Group is the world’s leading technology partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard to reach high value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality. **JOB DESCRIPTION:**
--------------------

**About Us**
------------

HBX Group is the world’s leading technological partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We bring together global and local brands across accommodation, transport, activities and payments, supported by a network of over 300,000 hotels and 60,000 travel partners worldwide. We are tech‑driven, customer‑focused, and powered by exceptional people. At HBX Group, we believe **tech + data + people** is what truly sets us apart.

---------------

This is **not a step‑up role** — we require someone who can immediately step in, lead confidently, and deliver.

Transfers experience is ideal, but strong travel sector sourcing backgrounds will also be considered. The role involves hands‑on leadership, supplier engagement, willingness to pick up the phone, and active “on‑the‑pitch” involvement when required. You will also directly manage two Sourcing Executive Administrators and ensure strong audit and governance discipline across the team.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Lead and manage the full Transfers Sourcing team (approx. 12 people), overseeing performance, delivery and professional development.
* Ensure strong audit, governance, and compliance standards across the sourcing function, including direct management of two Sourcing Executive Administrators.
* Drive commercial results by negotiating competitive rates, terms, and service delivery with transport suppliers.
* Oversee supplier relationships, ensuring quality, operational excellence, and adherence to SLAs.

* Act as a hands‑on leader — comfortable making calls, joining operational discussions, and representing the department confidently.
* Identify growth opportunities within sourcing and champion new initiatives aligned with business strategy.

**Skillset and Experience Required**
------------------------------------

* Proven leadership experience at **Head‑of‑level**, with strong results‑driven delivery in sourcing or travel procurement.
* Experience managing transport or travel suppliers; Transfers experience highly desirable.
* Strong governance, audit, and compliance mindset within a sourcing function.
* Ability to manage and motivate a geographically dispersed and multicultural team.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder‑management skills across all levels of HBX Group.
* Hands‑on, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast‑paced, high‑pressure environment.
* Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to balance cost, service, and operational impact.

* Willingness to travel and to engage directly with suppliers when required.

title: CISO AI
description:
Job Description:

We are seeking a forward-thinking security leader to become our AI CISO. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of AI security at a global scale, protecting our models, data, and infrastructure from emerging threats while fostering responsible and ethical AI innovation.

**About the job**

**Job purpose**

Your purpose is to build and run a holistic AI security program for AXA. You will establish the governance, risk management framework, and security controls to protect our AI/ML models and data, ensuring that AXA's use of AI is not only powerful but also secure and trustworthy.

**Main missions**

Your mission is to build the program around the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, adapted for AI:

* Govern: Develop and follow implementation the Group's AI Security Strategy, in line with responsible AI principles and emerging regulations (e.g., EU AI Act). Establish policies for secure AI development, data usage, and model governance
* Identify: Lead risk assessments methodology design on AI models and systems, focusing on unique threats like data poisoning, model evasion, adversarial attacks, and prompt injection. Ensure a consolidate inventory of critical AI assets
* Protect: Define security standards and architecture patterns for the AI/ML lifecycle, from secure data acquisition and feature engineering to model training and deployment. Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of models and training data
* Detect: Oversee the implementation of monitoring mechanisms to detect model drift, anomalous behavior, and security attacks against AI systems. Define AI-specific incident precursors for the SOC
* Respond & Recover: Define and test the incident response playbook for AI-specific security events, such as a compromised model or a severe data leak through a Generative AI service

**Expected skills & experience**

We are looking for someone with the following experience and skills:

**Experience**

More than 10 years of experience in Information Security or a related field, with demonstrated experience in a leadership role focused on data science, AI/ML, or the security thereof.

**Technical skills**

* Good understanding of the AI/ML lifecycle
* Knowledge of common AI frameworks
* Familiarity with AI-specific security threats (adversarial ML, etc.) and controls
* Knowledge of data privacy and emerging AI regulations is essential

**Soft skills / transversal skills**

Profile

* Fluent in English. Outstanding oral and written communication skills with proven ability to develop and present concise information
* Strong multi-cultural understanding
* Experience of interacting with Directors and all levels of management
* Team player and able to collaborate, influence and guide others

Strategic Mindset

* A passion for innovation balanced with a pragmatic, risk-based approach. Ability to think strategically and establish a new function in a complex, global organization
* Maintains a wider perspective, aligns actions and contributes to the enhancement of the overall organizational strategy, including outputs from benchmarking activities and reviews
* Understands and articulates the projected direction of the organization and how changes to it might impact the group
* Is aware of trends in the external environment and key differentiators vis-à-vis competition and uses this information to anticipate how these changes would impact the organization

Leadership / Stakeholder Management / Communication:

* A visionary leader capable of navigating ambiguity and influencing a wide range of stakeholders to adopt new security paradigms in a matrix organization
* Ability to build consensus and drive collaboration between highly technical data science teams, business units, AXA Group functions, and AXA entities.
* Exceptional ability to communicate in English, translating complex AI security concepts into clear, actionable guidance for diverse audiences from developers to senior executives

**Where will you be in the organization?**

**The department / team**

* The division: As the thematic CISO for Artificial Intelligence within Group Security, you will be AXA's leading expert on AI security. You will partner with data science teams, innovation hubs, and local CISOs to ensure our AI initiatives are secure, trustworthy, and compliant.

  

* The department / team: Operating within a global matrix structure, you will use your leadership and influence to embed security into the entire AI lifecycle across all AXA entities. Your mission is to make "secure AI" a core principle of every project, ensuring our innovation is built on a foundation of trust.

**What we offer**

We bring together the expertise, cultural diversity and creativity of over 8,000 employees worldwide and we’re committed to equal opportunities in all aspects of employment (gender, LGBT+, disabled persons, or people of different origins) and to promoting Diversity & Inclusion by creating a work environment where all employees are treated with dignity and respect, and where individual differences are valued.

title: Social Media Strategist
description:
**About us**

Do you live to create? Looking for your next big challenge? How about a breath of fresh air? As part of the Omnicom Agencies Group, the 14 Agency network handles all global advertising for CUPRA and SEAT car brands. With offices in 11 countries and counting, 14 is a place for those who like to bend the rules. It's a place for rock'n'roll. At the heart of Barcelona, and beyond.

It is also a place where a diverse mix of talented people want to come, to stay and do their best work. Our dedication to promoting diversity, multiculturalism, and inclusion is clearly reflected in our teams and across all of our work. Diversity is more than a commitment for us — it is the foundation of what we do.

**Role Purpose**

We are looking for a Social Media Strategist to join the CUPRA Global Social Strategy team. Someone with an insatiable curiosity about digital culture, platforms, and communities, and the ability to translate all of that into strategy.

Someone who experiences the internet beyond their feed; who understands the lore, knows what's behind the screenmaxing, and recognizes when something is "that's so AI." Someone who scrolls with curiosity, knows how to separate the noise from the signals that matter, and connects what's happening online with what's happening in the real world.

Your challenge will be to transform this constant reading of culture into strategic opportunities for CUPRA. Because knowing what's happening online is good; understanding what it means for the brand and what to do with it is what makes the difference.

**Responsibilities**

***1. Social Media Strategy***

Develop social strategies aligned with CUPRA's positioning and objectives.

Define opportunities, territories, and strategic approaches to build a relevant and distinctive social presence.

Translate brand and business challenges into actionable strategies, briefs, and recommendations.

Contribute to evolving the role of social media within CUPRA's global strategy.

***2. Cultural & Audience Intelligence***

Identify cultural shifts, behaviors, communities, and conversations relevant to the brand.

Analyze platforms and audiences to understand what motivates them, how they engage, and what they expect from brands.

Transform cultural and social insights into strategic perspectives and opportunities for CUPRA.

Distinguish between a trend that deserves attention and an opportunity that warrants a brand response.

***3. Strategic Development & Measurement***

Develop strategic frameworks and criteria to guide social media decisions.

Work with Social Creative, Content Planning, and Data to connect strategy, ideas, and results.

Evaluate the contribution of social media initiatives to brand objectives, incorporating lessons learned into future strategies.

Present and defend strategic recommendations to teams and stakeholders.

***Profile we are looking for:***

Experience in Social Media Strategy, Digital Strategy, or brand and communications strategy.

Solid knowledge of the main social media platforms and their codes.

Curiosity about contemporary culture, communities, entertainment, and audience behavior.

Ability to transform information into insights and insights into a clear strategic direction.

Critical thinking, independent judgment, and the ability to construct and defend a point of view.

Ability to connect brand, business, culture, and social media without resorting to generic approaches.

Good communication and presentation skills, autonomy, and the ability to work in a team.

Advanced English; experience with global brands is a plus.

Demonstrable experience understanding social media and internet culture.

**In short**: someone who not only understands what's happening on social media, but also what it means for CUPRA and what the brand should do about it.

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sexual orientation, or age.

Your personal information will be used according to our Recruitment Privacy Notice. View our Recruitment Privacy Notice here when you apply.

Director, Supply Chain Strategy
description:
**Role highlights:**

* Director, Supply Chain Strategy
* Location: FInland, Germany or Spain
* Department: Global Supply Chain
* Reports to: Global Director Supply Chain
* Employment type: Permanent
* Workplace model: Hybrid
* Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

**Why this role matters - The mission**
---------------------------------------

We are seeking a strategic, commercially and legally strong Director, Supply Chain Strategy to shape how ICEYE secures, de-risks and scales the supply base behind the world's largest multisensor satellite constellation.

You will own ICEYE's global supply chain strategy: how we assess and manage supplier risk, which suppliers we develop as long-term partners, and where we vertically integrate through partnerships, licensing, joint ventures or acquisitions. You will also define and own our supplier portal landscape, the digital backbone of how we collaborate with suppliers. Finally, you will own how ICEYE meets local content requirements, supporting our local entities as they select and onboard in-country suppliers.

This role is for a leader who moves comfortably between the boardroom and the engineering bench: credible with executives, investors and partners, and equally credible with electrical, mechanical, manufacturing and supplier engineers.

**Who we are**
--------------

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defense and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

**Your day-to-day responsibilities**

### **1. Global supply chain strategy**

* Define and own ICEYE's global supply chain strategy, aligned with company, program and production roadmaps, and translate it into a multi-year plan with clear priorities, targets and KPIs.
* Establish and run a structured supplier risk assessment framework covering financial health, capacity, single and sole sourcing, geopolitical and export control exposure, security and compliance.
* Build and maintain a supplier risk heat-map across all critical commodities and suppliers, and use it to drive mitigation plans, dual sourcing and inventory strategies.
* Own supplier due diligence for new and strategic suppliers, including ownership and security screening, ESG and compliance checks, in close cooperation with Legal, Security and Quality.
* Lead supplier development programs that lift capability, quality and capacity of strategic suppliers, and grow a resilient, sovereign-capable supply base for defense and dual-use customers.

### **2. Strategic partnerships & ventures**

* Identify, evaluate and execute vertical integration opportunities where owning or controlling critical technologies, processes or capacity creates strategic advantage.
* Support the negotiation of long-term and strategic supply agreements, including pricing, capacity reservation, IP, liability, security and exit terms.
* Structure and negotiate license agreements and joint venture agreements with industrial and technology partners.
* Act as the M&A lead in the vertical integration domain: build the target pipeline, lead technical and operational due diligence, shape business cases and drive post-merger integration of acquired capabilities into the supply chain.
* Work closely with Corporate Development, Finance and Legal, and present recommendations to the executive team and board.

### **3. Supplier portals**

* Define and own ICEYE's supplier portal strategy, roadmap and architecture.
* Lead the selection, implementation and continuous improvement of supplier portals for onboarding, qualification, forecasting, order collaboration, document exchange and performance scorecards.
* Ensure portals integrate with ERP and PLM, and meet ICEYE's information security and export control requirements.
* Drive supplier adoption and use portal data to improve visibility, risk monitoring and decision making.

### **4. Local content & local supply**

* Own ICEYE's approach to local content, industrial participation and offset requirements in customer programs and sovereign missions.
* Assess local content obligations early in bids and contracts, and translate them into sourcing plans with clear targets and tracking.
* Support ICEYE's local entities in identifying, assessing, selecting and onboarding local suppliers, applying ICEYE's risk assessment, due diligence and qualification standards.
* Develop local suppliers so they can meet ICEYE's technical, quality and security requirements, and integrate them into the global supply base and supplier portals.
* Report on local content performance and compliance to program teams, local entity leadership and customers.

### **5. Leadership & organization development**

* Build, lead and develop a team of supply chain strategy, strategic sourcing and supplier management professionals, including managers.
* Define the operating model, workflows and governance for strategic sourcing and supply continuity across electronics, mechanical, electromechanical and specialty process categories.
* Develop hiring profiles, succession plans and long-term talent strategies to scale the organization.
* Foster a culture of urgency, technical rigor, proactive risk management and high accountability.

### **6. Securing serial supply continuity**

* Partner with the Supply Chain Category Managers, who own category strategies and day-to-day supply continuity for serial production, and ensure the supply chain strategy actively supports their goals.
* Identify structural supply risks that category management alone cannot resolve, such as single and sole sources, capacity bottlenecks, obsolescence, technology dependencies and geopolitical exposure.
* Propose and execute structural solutions that secure continuous supply: strategic partnerships, long-term supply agreements, licensing, joint ventures, vertical integration and M&A.
* Build business cases with Category Management, Finance and Engineering that compare make, buy, partner and acquire options.
* Track how these initiatives improve supply security, lead-times and cost at rate.

### **7. Supporting supplier engagement**

* Support the Supply Chain Category Managers, who own the relationships with suppliers in their categories, including executive-level engagement with strategic suppliers where needed.
* Bring the strategic view into supplier relationships: risk heat-map findings, due diligence results, supplier development needs and partnership or integration opportunities.
* Support Category Managers in negotiations that need long-term agreements, capacity commitments or partnership structures.

### **8. Cross-functional & executive alignment**

* Act as the senior supply chain voice in executive, engineering, program management and manufacturing forums.
* Translate evolving technical and business requirements into executable supply chain strategies across electronics, mechanical and system-level builds.
* Communicate risks, mitigation plans and critical dependencies proactively to leadership and program teams.

### **9. Risk management & development-to-production continuity**

* Identify and mitigate risks to continuous supply, including component availability, obsolescence, material constraints, export limitations, supplier capacity and financial stability.
* Ensure supply risks are visible at program milestones and production readiness reviews (PRR).
* Drive early qualification of alternate components, materials, processes and sources.
* Ensure engineering and product teams understand how design decisions affect supply resilience, lead-times and cost at rate.
* Support Continuous Production Configurations with sourcing strategies that scale across electronics and mechanical domains.

**What we’re looking for**

**Must haves:**

* MBA and/or a law degree (LL.M. or equivalent), combined with a technical background, ideally a degree in engineering or a related discipline.
* 8+ years in supply chain, strategic sourcing or supply management roles in hardware-intensive industries, with 5+ years leading teams, including managers.
* Proven track record of defining and executing supply chain strategy, including supplier risk management, supplier due diligence and supplier development programs.
* Hands-on experience negotiating and structuring strategic supply agreements, license agreements and joint ventures, and supporting or leading M&A transactions, ideally in a vertical integration context.
* Strong understanding of commercial and contract law, including IP, liability, compliance and export control topics.
* Solid technical understanding of hardware supply chains.
* Experience defining and implementing supplier portals or supplier collaboration platforms integrated with ERP and PLM.
* Demonstrated success securing continuous supply in serial or rate production environments.
* Strong executive communication, negotiation, commercial and cross-functional leadership skills.

**Nice to haves:**

* Experience in space, aerospace, defense or other regulated high-reliability industries.
* Familiarity with export control regimes (EU dual-use, ITAR/EAR) and security-cleared supply chains, and with local content, industrial participation or offset requirements in defense programs.
* Experience in corporate development, M&A advisory, strategy consulting or legal counsel for industrial transactions.
* Experience building supply chains across Europe, North America and Asia.

### **Benefits**

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Base salary range for this position is **[xxxx–xxxx local currency] per month (gross)**, dependant on experience, and will be negotiated individually.

### **Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

title: Executive Chef
description:

**Branch:** Zest Hotel and Resort

**Contract type:** Permanent

**Hours:** Full Time

**About ZEST Hotel Resort Ibiza**

ZEST Hotel Resort is where dynamic energy meets effortless luxury. Designed for those who seek both indulgence and authenticity, we create a space where creativity thrives and every moment is a celebration of the senses. From vibrant days by the pool to elegant evenings under the stars, ZEST pulses with movement, music, and connection. Our approach to luxury is relaxed yet refined, stylish, welcoming, and always inspiring. Here, pleasure is an art, and every stay is an unforgettable experience.

ZEST Hotel Resort is a new luxury resort in Cap Negret, Ibiza, scheduled to open in April 2027. With 206 rooms and seven villas, destination dining, wellness facilities, and a Beach Club, we are building a team that will bring warm, thoughtful hospitality to every part of the guest experience.

  

**About the Role**

Lead the culinary vision behind one of Ibiza's most exciting luxury resort openings.

As we prepare for opening, we are looking for an exceptional Executive Chef to join our Executive Leadership Team and help shape the culinary identity of this landmark resort.

This is an opportunity to do much more than lead a kitchen. We are seeking a culinary leader who can create memorable dining experiences, develop innovative concepts, build an outstanding brigade, and establish a food culture that celebrates the energy, creativity, and natural abundance of Ibiza.

Reporting to the Director of Food Beverage, the Executive Chef will have overall responsibility for the culinary strategy, food quality, and kitchen operations across the resort.

Working closely with the Food Beverage leadership team and wider resort stakeholders, you will help define and deliver the culinary vision of ZEST across restaurants, bars, Pool Club, in-room dining, banqueting, and special events. You will play a key role in translating the ZEST brand into exceptional dining experiences while balancing creativity, operational excellence, team development, and commercial performance.

As part of the pre-opening team, you will help establish kitchen infrastructure, recruit and develop the culinary team, create menus and concepts, and ensure operational readiness ahead of launch.

  

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and deliver the overall culinary vision and food strategy for ZEST Hotel Resort Ibiza.
* Create innovative menus and dining concepts that combine Mediterranean and Ibicenco influences with contemporary international cuisine.
* Champion local, seasonal, and sustainable ingredients, building strong partnerships with Ibizan and Balearic suppliers and producers.
* Lead all culinary operations across restaurants, bars, Pool Club, in-room dining, events, banqueting, and employee dining facilities.
* Recruit, develop, coach, and inspire a high-performing culinary team, creating a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Establish kitchen structures, operational standards, recipes, procedures, and working practices ahead of opening.
* Collaborate closely with the Director of Food Beverage on concept development, menu engineering, pricing strategies, and guest experience enhancement.
* Drive food quality, consistency, creativity, and presentation standards across all outlets.
* Manage food costs, labor productivity, purchasing, inventory controls, and departmental budgets to achieve financial objectives.
* Lead seasonal menu development and adapt offerings to reflect market trends, guest preferences, and Ibiza's operating seasons.
* Embed sustainability, responsible sourcing, waste reduction, and environmental best practices throughout the culinary operation.
* Ensure full compliance with HACCP, food safety, hygiene, health and safety, and all regulatory requirements.
* Monitor guest feedback, culinary trends, and competitive positioning to drive innovation and continuous improvement.
* Support resort events, VIP experiences, brand activations, and special culinary collaborations.
* Contribute to all pre-opening activities, including kitchen design reviews, equipment selection, supplier sourcing, training programs, and operational readiness planning.

**Experience Qualifications**

* Culinary degree or professional qualification in Culinary Arts, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
* Significant leadership experience as an Executive Chef, Executive Sous Chef, or senior culinary leader within a luxury hotel, resort, lifestyle brand, or high-end multi-outlet operation.
* Demonstrated success managing multiple restaurants and diverse culinary concepts within a complex hospitality environment.
* Strong understanding of Mediterranean cuisine, local sourcing, seasonality, and international food trends.
* Proven experience developing successful restaurant concepts, menus, and guest dining experiences.
* Strong commercial acumen with expertise in food cost management, labor control, purchasing, budgeting, and profitability.
* Experience recruiting, developing, and leading large culinary teams.
* Previous hotel or resort pre-opening experience is highly desirable.
* In-depth knowledge of HACCP, food safety regulations, and Spanish/EU compliance requirements.
* Fluent in English and Spanish.
* Valid EU work authorization or the appropriate Spanish work permit.

Key Competencies

* Creative and visionary culinary leadership.
* Passion for exceptional food quality and guest experiences.
* Strong commercial and business acumen.
* Inspirational leadership and team development skills.
* Operational excellence and attention to detail.
* Innovation, adaptability, and continuous improvement mindset.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder management abilities.
* Alignment with ZEST values, culture, and service philosophy.

  

**Benefits**

At ZEST, we believe exceptional culinary experiences are at the heart of unforgettable hospitality. As Executive Chef, you will have the opportunity to create and lead a food program that becomes a defining part of the guest experience and a benchmark within Ibiza's luxury hospitality scene.

* Competitive executive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunity to join the Executive Leadership Team of a landmark luxury resort.
* Be part of a pre-opening project and shape the culinary identity from day one.
* Creative freedom to develop concepts, menus, and experiences that reflect the ZEST brand.
* Opportunities for professional growth, development, and industry recognition.
* Employee recognition and engagement initiatives that celebrate success and performance.
* The opportunity to make a lasting impact on one of Ibiza's most exciting luxury hospitality destinations.
* Work within a culture driven by the ZEST Effect, where passion, creativity, collaboration, and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do.

**Why Join Us?**

This is far more than a traditional Executive Chef role.

You will join the team responsible for launching one of Ibiza's most exciting new luxury lifestyle resorts, helping define its culinary identity, dining concepts, guest experiences, and long-term reputation from day one.

This is a **fixed-term appointment** with an initial duration of 4 years. Depending upon performance and organisational needs, the appointment may be extended up to a possible maximum duration of 8 years.

  

**Location**
  
ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands with a resident assignment to ESAC, Villanueva de la Cañada, Spain.

**Description**
---------------

The Directorate of Human and Robotic Exploration Programmes (D/HRE) is a programme directorate within the ESA matrix structure. Through a partnership between humans and robots, D/HRE is dedicated to exploring destinations in space where humans are already living and working —– or will live and work in the future —– for the purpose of scientific research, economic development, international cooperation and public inspiration.

The Science Operations Department (SCI-S), within ESA’s Directorate of Science (D/SCI), hosts the scientists and engineers who oversee the space missions from study to the end of operations, develops the science operation systems for the missions and operates the missions in space, and archives and curates their data during operations and beyond. The Department provides support to D/HRE in the curation, archiving and dissemination of data from its planetary missions, such as the Rosalind Franklin Mission (RFM) and other Mars or lunar experiments. Its main objective is to maximise the scientific output of the missions for the benefit of humankind.

You will be assigned as Archive Scientist for ESA planetary missions under the direct responsibility of the Chief Exploration Scientist reporting functionally to the Head of the Science Archives Development and Operations Section, also known as the ESAC Science Data Centre (ESDC) in the Data Science and Archives Division within the Science Operations Department (SCI-S).

You will have further functional reporting lines within the mission(s) you support, initially the ESA ExoMars RFM and Comet Interceptor.

**Duties**
----------

You will be responsible for the definition and specification of the scientific archive for the supported ESA planetary missions, initially the ESA ExoMars RFM and Comet Interceptor, and for the follow-up and monitoring of its implementation and operation with the goal of maximising the scientific return of the missions. You will work in close collaboration with the planetary mission project scientists, the other mission archive scientists, the ESDC Software and Data Systems Architect and the members of the Planetary Science Archive User Group.

  

As Archive Scientist, your specific responsibilities will include:

  

* ownership of use cases and drivers for the mission archives, including:
  + interfacing with the Project Scientist, the Science Operations Centre (SOC) team, other archive science leads and other archive scientists, as well as the external stakeholders, such as the instrument teams and the mission scientific community, to provide the science use cases that drive the mission archive and determine the priorities for implementation;
  + providing scientific support and steering the development and operations of the archives for the supported ESA planetary missions, providing the ESDC development team with an archive user requirements document as a baseline for implementation;
* chairing and coordinating a mission-level Data Archive Working Group (DAWG);
* monitoring the implementation, testing and expected performance of the archive based on use cases gathered by the mission team and derived requirements; in particular, defining and performing the end user acceptance testing of the different archive versions prior to their release to the scientific community;
* with the help of the instrument operations scientists, supervising and coordinating the definition and provision of science data products and any higher-level data products from the community or instrument teams as needed, including liaising on submission schedules and content;
* liaising with any internal and external providers to ensure the completeness of all levels of data products with maximum science quality, contributing to the optimisation and refinement of the archive products when possible;
* encouraging and contributing to the science exploitation of the missions’ data products through archive usage;
* participating in archive scientist meetings and user groups and sharing ideas and proposals for the strategy and promotion of the ESA science archives;
* supporting the scientific community with archive- and data product-related matters.
  

As a scientist in the Department, you will be required to actively pursue personal scientific research, publishing articles using archival data, and to actively participate in the Department’s research activities.

**Technical competencies**
--------------------------

Experience in science data management and archiving systems

Experience working with planetary science data in a research setting, preferably including data from surface/in situ planetary missions

Experience in coordinating the scientific community and managing multiple interfaces at international level within a large multidisciplinary team.

Experience in science operations, preferably in the context of ESA missions

**Behavioural competencies**
----------------------------

Result Orientation
  
Operational Efficiency
  
Fostering Cooperation
  
Relationship Management
  
Continuous Improvement
  
Forward Thinking

**Education and professional experience**
-----------------------------------------

A PhD in a relevant domain is required for this post, together with one year of relevant professional experience.

**Additional requirements**
---------------------------

The following are assets for this position:

  

* Experience in promoting science to the wider scientific community and general public;
* Understanding of user needs in relation to complex software systems;
* Experience in science operations, preferably in the context of ESA missions;
* Experience in agile and DevOps methodologies, human factor engineering (UX design) and associated technologies and their use in modern software engineering.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusiveness**
  
ESA is an equal opportunity employer, committed to achieving diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. We therefore welcome applications from all qualified candidates irrespective of gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, age, disability or other characteristics.

At the Agency we value diversity, and we welcome people with disabilities. Whenever possible, we seek to accommodate individuals with disabilities by providing the necessary support at the workplace. The Human Resources Department can also provide assistance during the recruitment process. If you would like to discuss this further, please contact us via email at contact.human.resources@esa.int.

  

**Important Information and Disclaimer**
  
In principle, recruitment will be within the advertised grade band (A2-A4). However, if the selected candidate has less than four years of relevant professional experience following the completion of the master’s degree, the position may be filled at A1 level.

Applicants must be eligible to access information, technology, and hardware which is subject to European or US export control and sanctions regulations.

During the recruitment process, the Agency may request applicants to undergo selection tests. Additionally, successful candidates will need to undergo basic screening before appointment, which will be conducted by an external background screening service, in compliance with the European Space Agency's security procedures.

Note that ESA is in the process of transitioning to a Matrix setup, which could lead to organisational changes affecting this position.

The information published on ESA’s careers website regarding working conditions is correct at the time of publication. It is not intended to be exhaustive and may not address all questions you would have.

  

**Nationality and Languages**
  
Please note that applications are only considered from nationals of one of the following States: Austria, Belgium, Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, the United Kingdom and Canada, Cyprus, Latvia, Lithuania and Slovakia.

title: Director de Software Delivery
description:
Buscamos un **Director de Software Delivery**

**Perfil buscado**

* Más de 12 años en ingeniería y entrega de software, de los cuales al menos 5 en dirección de delivery, DevOps o plataforma.
* Experiencia implantando CI/CD, release management y metodología de SDLC en organizaciones grandes y con múltiples proveedores.
* Experiencia en gobierno de APIs y conocimiento práctico de MCP y del desarrollo asistido por IA.
* Perfil con base técnica sólida, con credibilidad ante los equipos y capacidad para exigir estándares a los proveedores. No se busca un perfil exclusivamente metodológico o de agile coach.

**Encaje en la organización**

Una de sus funciones es mediar entre Run y Change y gobernar un calendario unificado de releases para ambos.

Su eficacia depende sobre todo de las áreas que entregan y operan el software fuera del área del CTO.

**Fuera del área del CTO**

* Dominios de producto. Son el principal interlocutor. Aplican la metodología en sus proyectos, sean internos o externalizados, y la exigen a sus proveedores. Software Delivery les da un proceso claro y les acompaña en su adopción.
* PMO. Alinea la planificación y el seguimiento de proyectos con la metodología y con el calendario de releases.
* SRE. Define con Software Delivery los criterios de paso a producción, la observabilidad y el rollback, y aporta las métricas de fallo de cambios y tiempo de recuperación.
* Infraestructura. Provee los entornos y la infraestructura sobre los que se ejecutan los pipelines y los entornos no productivos.
* Soporte. Recibe cada release con la comunicación y el traspaso a Run adecuados, y aporta las incidencias posteriores a cada subida como indicador de calidad.
* IT4IT. Provee y opera las herramientas del ciclo de vida (requisitos, repositorios, CI/CD, gestión de servicios), conforme a los estándares definidos por Software Delivery.

**Dentro del área del CTO**

* Arquitectura y UX. Definen sus estándares; Software Delivery garantiza que intervienen en cada proyecto mediante puntos de control obligatorios.
* QA. Define la estrategia de pruebas y su automatización; Software Delivery la integra como gate en la plataforma CI/CD y en el flujo entre entornos.
* IA. Construye el framework de desarrollo agéntico; Software Delivery lo industrializa dentro del SDLC.
* Ciberseguridad. Valida los controles de seguridad de los pipelines, las APIs y los servidores MCP.

title: Lead Motion & Graphic Designer
description:
**TripleTen**
is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.
  
  
As a Lead Motion & Graphic Designer in the Curriculum team, you’ll turn complex tech concepts into clear visual and interactive learning experiences, and lead the team that makes them. About 80% of your time goes to hands-on design, motion, video, and interactive work; the other 20% to team leadership. Curriculum visuals help students understand and remember a concept, so we favor clarity, calm pacing, and accurate diagrams over flashy effects.
  
  
What you will do:
  
  

* Design learning visuals. Create graphics, animations, motion pieces, and explainer videos with Learning Experience Designers, from concept and storyboard to final edit.
* Set the quality bar. Own visual and motion standards for curriculum content: guidelines, templates, and reusable asset libraries.
* Lead the team. Run critiques, weekly planning, and retros; mentor designers with regular, actionable feedback; improve intake, reviews, and handoffs.
* Speed up production. Partner with product, design, and engineering on shared libraries, AI-assisted workflows, and automation of repetitive work.
* Prototype interactive formats. Design clickable diagrams, simple simulations, and step-by-step visual explainers for our learning platform.
* Finish video. Edit and enhance video content, adding simple visual effects and sound design.
* Experiment with new formats. Test new video and interactive formats, using Claude Design and Claude Code to prototype faster.

Requirements:
  
  
**Must have**

* 4+ years in motion and graphic design. A portfolio showing motion, graphic design, and visual storytelling, built in After Effects, Premiere Pro, and Figma.
* Design leadership. Experience leading or mentoring designers, or owning design standards and processes for a team.
* English at B2 or higher. Confident written and spoken English for daily work in a remote, cross-functional team.

**Nice to have**

* Interactive and UX work. Interactive pieces in your portfolio, and a grasp of how people read, scan, and interact with learning materials.
* AI creative tools. Hands-on use of Claude Design, Claude Code, or AI agents in Figma to prototype.
* Ed-tech and languages. Experience in ed-tech, e-learning, or instructional design; Spanish or Portuguese.

What we can offer you:
  
  

* Ownership. Real decision-making power in your area: we trust your expertise and don’t micromanage.
* Remote and flexible. Fully remote collaboration.
* Digital office. Slack, Notion, Miro, and Zoom, with every license you need.

**Sobre o Grupo**
O Grupo Largo Tempo integra um conjunto diversificado de empresas, incluindo a marca hoteleira Neya Hotels, desenvolvendo atividade em áreas como hotelaria, imobiliário, investimento e outros serviços.

Mais do que um especialista numa única área, procuramos uma pessoa versátil, autónoma, organizada e orientada para resultados, capaz de gerir projetos de marketing de ponta a ponta, coordenar fornecedores, acompanhar orçamentos e garantir a implementação eficaz das iniciativas de comunicação e marketing das várias empresas do Grupo.
  
Esta função reportará diretamente à Administração e terá um papel central no desenvolvimento da notoriedade das marcas, geração de negócio e acompanhamento do desempenho das ações de marketing.

* Coordenar ações de email marketing e automação.
* Definir métricas de sucesso e acompanhar KPIs de desempenho.
* Analisar resultados e propor ações de melhoria contínua.
* Garantir uma abordagem orientada para retorno do investimento e geração de valor para o negócio.

* Trabalhar com designers, fotógrafos, videógrafos, agências e outros parceiros especializados.

* Contribuir para o reforço do posicionamento premium e sustentável da Neya Hotels e das restantes empresas do Grupo.

* Gerir e acompanhar mensalmente a execução dos orçamentos aprovados.
* Monitorizar despesas, compromissos e investimentos, assegurando o cumprimento dos limites orçamentais definidos.

* Definir prioridades e assegurar o cumprimento dos prazos acordados.
* Atuar como ponto de contacto entre as diferentes empresas do Grupo e os parceiros externos.

As a leader in an ambitious & transforming organisation, the Associate Director - Marketing & Communications will be responsible for shaping & driving a contemporary marketing & communications approach that increases the profile, reach & reputation of BUCS, supports organisational strategy outcomes & strengthens the value we provide to students, member institutions & partners.

The Associate Director - Marketing & Communications will use professional marketing expertise to build commercial potential & support the effective servicing of commercial partners, whilst ensuring that the marketing & communications needs of members remain central to BUCS’ approach. Reporting to the CEO, the Associate Director - Marketing & Communications will provide strategic leadership for the effective development & delivery of BUCS’ activity in this area, ensuring that content, campaigns, channels & platforms are aligned to organisational priorities & the needs of our audiences.

The Associate Director - Marketing & Communications will work closely with the Senior Leadership Team, Management Team, members, participants, partners & wider stakeholders to ensure that BUCS’ marketing & communications activity is creative, contemporary, inclusive & impactful.

* Provide strategic leadership to BUCS’ marketing & communications functions, ensuring activity is innovative, contemporary, dynamic & aligned to organisational strategy.
* Develop & deliver a strategic marketing & communications programme that increases the reach, reputation & influence of BUCS across higher education, sport & wider stakeholder audiences, whilst creating value for members, participants & partners.
* Work as a member of the Senior Leadership Team, contributing to collective organisational leadership, strategic decision-making & the delivery of BUCS’ wider strategic priorities, with appropriate budget management & responsibilities.
* Develop creative & contemporary approaches to marketing with & to students, using insight to increase engagement, support entries to BUCS sport events & generate excitement & momentum with students for BUCS sporting offer & partner activations.
